**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**Who You Are**
 Love making things happen? Do you get a weird amount of satisfaction from a perfectly organized spreadsheet, a seamless workflow, and a team running like a well\-oiled machine? We should talk.
   

  

 At Tactical, we build the kind of work people actually stop to watch—producing world\-class creative for global giants like Spotify, Snapchat, and Amazon. But brilliant creative doesn’t just happen by magic. It takes an absolute mastermind behind the scenes to keep the chaos organized, protect the budgets, and turn wild ideas into reality.
   

  

 This isn't a "sit back and take notes" kind of job. You’ll be the operational anchor of our agency, owning the Project Management function, mentoring a killer team of PMs, and personally steering our biggest, most complex projects.
   

  

 In short:
 **You’ll own the function. Lead the team. Run the most important projects.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Leveling up the team: Leading, coaching, and mentoring our PM team. You’ll build a culture of accountability, run 1\-to\-1s, and help them level up their commercial and project leadership skills.
* Guarding the framework: Setting the gold standard for how projects are scoped, planned, and delivered across the entire agency before they even hit production.
* Running the big gigs: Stepping up to personally drive our highest\-value, most complex, and strategically vital projects.
* Protecting the money: Ensuring our projects are as profitable as they are creative by catching scope creep early, managing budgets, and keeping delivery tight.
* System mastery: Acting as the ultimate guardian of our PM tool, Productive, ensuring all data is pristine, accurate, and trusted across the agency.
* Building bridges: Partnering with Creative, Client Services, and Finance to keep everyone aligned, navigate shifting priorities, and make sure PM is viewed as a strategic partner, not a support function.


**We're Looking For Someone Who..**
* Believes in great delivery: You know that strong project management isn’t just about tracking tasks—it’s about creating clarity and helping teams do their best work.
* Is calm in the wild: Organized by nature, you bring structure without the boring bureaucracy, and you thrive in fast\-moving agency environments where priorities pivot fast.
* Has the track record: You bring proven experience leading PM or delivery teams within a creative, social, or digital agency setup.
* Talks numbers and deadlines: You possess sharp commercial awareness and understand project profitability, resource allocations, and scoping inside out.
* Knows the tech stack: You are a pro at navigating agency management platforms like Productive, Monday.com, Asana, or similar tools.
* Brings the energy: You have zero ego, great communication skills, a solutions\-focused mindset, and a genuine passion for helping people grow.


 Think you’ve got what it takes to run the engine behind some of the best creative work in the world?
   

  

 Hit the link below to apply! 👇

Job Purpose:
 



 Oversee the planning, execution, and control of Rail Design’s Gold Line Metro portfolio, ensuring
 



 alignment with Dubai and RTA strategies, the Rail Network Plan 2032, and the corporate governance framework. Ensure the project is executed with high quality from start to finish. Provide strategic advice, monitor performance, and coordinate with partners to maintain compliant, efficient, and results\-driven delivery. Ensure program management components align with RTA’s strategic objectives, governance frameworks, quality standards, approved budgets, and operational excellence standards.
 



  





 Roles \& Accountabilities:
 



  





 Strategy
 



 • Serve as the primary advisor to RTA management and CEOs on Gold Line Metro portfolio priorities and benefits realization.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro rail design projects’ objectives are aligned with the RTA strategy, Dubai Strategic Plan, and Rail Network Plan 2032, with a focus on design standards, asset
 



 lifecycle, and infrastructure integration.
 



 • Ensure consistency between program objectives and Dubai’s wider urban development frameworks and approved transport and infrastructure masterplan.
 



 • Ensure Gold Line Metro projects comply with the governance framework and corporate and
 



 technical standards.
 



 • Lead strategic committees for Gold Line Metro projects and coordinate corporate partnerships, memberships, and participation in external forums/agreements; follow up on outputs and performance commitments.
 



 • Oversee tracking and review of program\-level design KPIs, including integration of sustainability requirements, cost\-efficient design solutions, and adherence to approved
 



 design delivery schedules.
 



 • Contribute to the review of construction policies, safety standards, and technical procedures in collaboration with engineering and quality teams.
 



 • Drive the integration of sustainability, environmental, safety, and resilience goals across project planning and execution, ensuring consistent adoption of green design standards, safety compliance, and environmental impact mitigation across the projects.
 



  





 Operations
 



 • Review and track design submissions, contractor mobilization, and work design progress to support delivery milestones.
 



 • Conduct review and provide preliminary approvals on vendor and contractor deliverables to
 



 ensure alignment with program requirements, rail design standards and agreed specifications.
 



 • Monitor Gold Line Metro program lifecycle and performance including milestones, budgets,
 



 resource utilization, risk/challenge analysis and deliverables; prepare progress and
 



 completion reports and highlight deviations and recovery actions to the CEO.
 



 • Provide oversight of value engineering reviews at key stages, reviewing comprehensive reports with recommendations for cost reduction, service improvement, and operational
 



 resilience.
 



 • Oversee and align multidisciplinary rail design, review, and approval process covering architectural, structural, civil, MEP, accessibility, and signage elements including amendments
 



 and updates to ensure compliance.
 



 • Review change orders for Gold Line Metro projects, analyze root causes and justifications, ensure need and data validity, and submit recommendations and reports to the CEO and concerned units.
 



 • Champion and standardize application of value management principles during Gold Line Metro project phases and measure project benefits.
 



 • Manage communication and relationships with government/semi\-government entities and external partners including engineering teams, consultants, and contractors to resolve operational bottlenecks.
 



 • Lead CEO meeting preparation and ensure readiness of required briefs, documents, and presentations.
 



 • Manage complaints, escalations and suggestions for project\-related design issues, contractor delays and technical non\-compliance and risks with internal entities to timely closure.
 



 • Oversee maintenance of documentation repositories and reporting systems to ensure
 



 traceability and transparency across all infrastructure design projects.
 



 • Oversee coordination with internal and external stakeholders, including transport authorities
 



 and urban planners, to ensure multimodal integration, right\-of\-way resolution, and seamless
 



 station connectivity.
 



  





 Product / Process Improvement
 



 • Champion digital transformation and predictive project control by integrating advanced tools
 



 (e.g., BIM, GIS, AI\-enabled project tracking) into design and commercial governance.
 



 • Review performance reports and statistical data to identify challenges and propose actionable
 



 solutions.
 



 • Assist in dissemination of pioneering practices and lessons learned from projects in rail.
 



 • Guide the benchmarking of rail design performance against global best practices and lead
 



 continuous\-improvement initiatives.
 



 • Provide recommendations on AI initiatives (including Proof of Concepts and use\-case
 



 validation); ensure compliance with corporate documents.
 



 • Promote a culture of innovation and motivate departments to adopt cutting\-edge solutions.
 



 • Support capacity\-building sessions and awareness initiatives to strengthen program and
 



 project delivery capabilities.
 



  





 Physical Working Conditions
 



 • Hybrid role with regular field visits, design coordination walkthroughs, site inspections,
 



 testing oversight, and handover reviews to ensure quality compliance, address issues, and
 



 validate design implementation.
 



  





 Education:
 



 Bachelor's degree/ Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, Construction Management or Infrastructure Planning.
 



  





 Experience:
 



 • 12\+ years in case of master’s degree (14\+ years in case of bachelor’s degree).
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience with at least 5 years of experience in program management in related functional area and 5 years of experience with government agencies.
 



  





 Qualification:
 



 Professional Certificate in Program Management (PgMP), PMP Certificate.

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To manage strategic project investments from consolidating and governing tasks and activities of various operations, commercial, support functions and external stakeholders, required for driving an overarching corporate PMO function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develops an overarching project plan for each strategic initiative and investment including consolidating aspects of all departmental plans.
* Coordinates the comprehensive collation of all tasks and activities to ensure successful completion of projects including those of external stakeholders.
* Directs and manages regular status review of each project whilst ensuring task and activity owners report back on progress accurately and in a timely manner.
* Conducts project performance and progress reviews, escalating delays or non\-performance issues for corrective action and/or appropriate performance recovery measures to get projects back on track.
* Ensures project timelines are stress tested for significant changes in delivery by stakeholders to assess impact on overall project completion and mitigation alternatives.
* Develops appropriate governance mechanisms for all projects including setting up Steering \& Working Group and ensure they are managed and/or informed at regular intervals on progress.
* Validates and assesses business cases for each project under management and ascertain benefits would be realized and proven by quantitative and qualitative KPI's defined for each project.
* Fosters close collaboration between Corporate PMO and Business Unit Project Managers to streamline project execution and ensure use of consistent methodologies.
* Develops and maintains a portfolio view of projects as ready reference for Chief's and SVP's update at short notice.
* Ensures project governance framework and processes for large corporate wide projects as defined by the Corporate Project Management office are adhered to.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree (3\+ years)
* Degree in any discipline and professional qualification or equivalent.
* Fluent in English
* Demonstrable experience in effectively managing projects, with a proven ability to plan, execute, and achieve desired outcomes within specified timelines.
* MS Project would be a advantage
* Years with qualifications: 7 \- 9 years
* A project management certification of PMI, PROSCI or other would be preferred.


**COMPETENCIES**
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork
* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability \& Commitment to achieve
* Resilience \& Flexibility (Can do attitude)
* Inspiring \& Developing Others
* Decision Making
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Acumen


**Isr Requirements**
 Reads and complies with the ISR policies of the Company and diligently reports any weakness or incidents to the respective Line Manager or the Information Security team. Completes all required ISR awareness sessions and follows associated guidelines in the day\-to\-day business operations.

The role is responsible for tracking project progress, developing executive dashboards and KPI reports, analyzing performance data, and providing actionable insights to support informed decision\-making and successful strategy execution across the sector.

* Monitor project progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and overall performance across multiple business units.
* Develop executive dashboards, performance reports, and visual analytics to support strategic decision\-making.
* Analyze large volumes of data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance insights.
* Design and maintain KPI frameworks, scorecards, and performance measurement systems.
* Prepare executive\-level reports and presentations for senior leadership.
* Collaborate with project managers and department heads to ensure timely project delivery and issue resolution.
* Implement project governance standards, reporting frameworks, and performance management methodologies.
* Drive continuous improvement by leveraging data analytics, business intelligence, and automation tools.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.
* PMP certification is highly desirable.
* Minimum
 **8–10 years of experience** 
 in project management, PMO, strategy execution, or performance management.
* Strong expertise in
 **Power BI, Excel (Advanced), Power Query, Power Pivot, SQL** 
 , or other business intelligence and data visualization tools.
* Proven experience developing executive dashboards, KPI frameworks, and performance reports.
* Experience working within government, public sector, or large complex organizations is highly preferred.
* Excellent analytical, presentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.



  





 We're seeking a strategic thinker with exceptional analytical capabilities who can transform complex data into actionable insights and help drive the successful delivery of key strategic initiatives.

data.jd_text:
Currie \& Brown is looking for a Senior Planning Manager to join our team in Dubai. You will lead in generating a high standard of service delivery, achieving successful outcomes for our clients, capturing and sharing knowledge across projects, enhancing our culture of innovation and reinforcing our reputation as a preferred service provider.
 



  





 We welcome applications from experienced Planning Managers with either a
 
 delay analysis/delay management background or a general planning/project controls background. The successful candidate will have strong programme management experience and the ability to support complex, high\-value construction projects through all stages of delivery.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Develop and manage the master programme
* Ongoing monitoring and reporting of all programme\-related activities.
* Proactive management / conducting detailed reviews of the contractor's programme.
* Monitor planning and project controls activities for conformance with project procedures.
* Develop and monitor the permitting and authority approvals process.
* Prepare the baseline programme.
* Prepare monthly reports and recovery plans, where applicable.
* Prepare and finalise weekly progress reports and quantity reports.
* Provide the Project Manager with weekly progress updates, completion forecasts, together with critical path and trend analyses.
* Continually assess the impact of approved changes and deviations from key project targets and milestones, including productivity monitoring and "what if" scenario analysis to support project decision\-making.
* Work collaboratively with the Project Manager, Engineer and Contractor to resolve project scheduling issues.
* Review and analyse contractors' claims and prepare recommendation reports where required.



  





  





 Skills, Experience \& Qualifications
 


* Experience working on high\-end mixed\-use projects.
* BSc in a relevant discipline.
* Significant pre\-contract and post\-contract planning experience on major construction projects.
* Experience in either delay analysis/delay management or general planning/project controls.
* Strong technical writing, communication and client\-facing skills.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6\.



  





 At Currie \& Brown, we know that when it comes to a good idea, it doesn't matter where it comes from. That's why we take a collaborative, open\-door approach to running our business. Our people, from apprentices to senior management, make our company what it is. Everyone in the Currie \& Brown family, no matter how experienced, contributes to our success in their own way, and we have fun doing it.
 



 Unlike other companies, we focus on the long term and deliver on our commitments. We take a compassionate and inclusive approach to our work and always invest in the future of our people. Whether it's the desire to work internationally, the urge to develop, or even the curiosity to work in a new sector, we are there for our people at every stage, offering guidance, support and the structure to achieve. That's why so many of us have been building successful careers here for so long.
 



 With the backing of our parent company, we are an independent company. Our people are able to make quick and flexible decisions, and work directly with some of the world's best partner brands in our industry through Dar Group.
 



 This mix of our scale and size, our partnerships and our people makes us a true industry leader around the world.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.
* Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

**Reports to:** 

 CEO / Board / relevant committee
 




**Location:** 

 UAE (ADGM or DIFC, as applicable)
 




**Status:** 

 Full\-time, senior leadership, approved person or equivalent
 




**Role purpose:** 

 Lead the operational operating model of a regulated retail investment platform, ensuring the business can safely scale client growth, maintain robust outsourcing governance, deliver reliable platform operations, and demonstrate strong operational resilience and control. The role owns the operational capability of the business, while working closely with Compliance, Risk, Legal, Technology, and client\-facing teams.
 





 ‍
 




  





**Key responsibilities:** 



* Own client onboarding operations, account opening workﬂow, veriﬁcation coordination, and operational throughput.
* Oversee platform operations, trade support, cash movements, reconciliations, and exception handling.
* Manage outsourcing relationships with brokers, custodians, technology vendors, payment providers, and support partners.
* Monitor SLAs, service incidents, backlog levels, and operational performance metrics.
* Lead business continuity planning, disaster recovery arrangements, and resilience testing.
* Coordinate operational implementation of regulatory or internal change projects.
* Maintain operational MI and dashboards for senior management and board review.
* Lead root\-cause analysis for operational incidents, control breaks, and process failures.
* Ensure documented handoﬀs and controls exist across all critical workﬂows, especially where services are outsourced.



**Regulatory accountability** 



* Maintain an operating model that supports safe retail client servicing, onboarding, trading, payments, reconciliations, and support.
* Ensure all outsourced and interdependent service providers are governed through clear SLAs, oversight routines, escalation paths, and documented controls.
* Maintain operational readiness for new client phases, product launches, or platform expansions.
* Ensure the ﬁrm can evidence operational resilience, incident response, and recovery capability to internal governance and regulators.
* Provide board\-ready reporting on capacity, service quality, incidents, remediation, and operational risk trends.



**Reserved matters and escalation rights** 



* No new client growth phase may proceed without documented operational readiness sign\-oﬀ.
* No new vendor, platform integration, or outsourced critical service may go live without testing, control validation, and approval.
* Material operational incidents, repeated SLA breaches, failed reconciliations, or control gaps must be escalated immediately to senior management and relevant committees.
* The Head of Operations may recommend suspension of onboarding, trading, or service activity where operational risk is not acceptably controlled.
* Material resilience or continuity weaknesses must be reported with remediation timelines and ownership.
* Operational evidence supporting regulator\-facing submissions must be reviewed and approved through the ﬁrmʼs governance process.



**Interfaces with Compliance:** 





 Operations owns execution, process control, resilience, and service delivery. Compliance owns regulatory interpretation, compliance monitoring, policy advice, and challenge. The Head of Operations should partner with Compliance on client onboarding controls, complaints routing, breach escalation, and regulatory change implementation.
 




  





**Candidate proﬁle:** 




**‍** 




**Must have** 



* 10\+ years in operations leadership within regulated ﬁnancial services, ﬁntech, wealth management, asset management, or retail investment platforms;
* 5\+ years at Head of Operations / COO level in a client\-facing regulated environment; strong track record of scaling operations through growth phases;
* Deep experience with outsourcing governance, broker/custodian relationships, and operational resilience;
* Strong governance, reporting, stakeholder management, and issue\-resolution skills.


- 


**Nice to have:** 




  




* Experience in ADGM or DIFC regulated environments;
* Familiarity with Islamic ﬁnance operational requirements;
* Experience with virtual assets operational infrastructure;
* Arabic language skills.

**BTSE** 
 Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white\-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more.
   

  

 BTSE has pioneered multiple trading technologies that have been widely adopted across the industry, establishing new benchmarks for innovation, performance, and security in digital asset trading. Consistently ranked among the top 10 global exchanges, BTSE is expanding rapidly and invites ambitious, driven professionals to become valuable members of its B2C and B2B businesses.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Head of Operations to lead the Dubai entity’s operations. This role will oversee day\-to\-day activities, establish operational frameworks, and support regulatory compliance and licensing.
   

  

**The successful candidate must meet VARA's fit and proper standards, including demonstrated integrity, relevant industry experience, an understanding of the virtual asset regulatory framework, and financial soundness**
**Responsibilities**
* Oversee daily operations across trading, payments, and client lifecycle.
* Establish and maintain operational processes, controls, and monitoring frameworks.
* Support licensing and act as a key point of contact for regulators, including VARA.
* Ensure alignment with compliance, risk, and internal policies.
* Identify and manage operational risks, including incident handling and escalation.
* Collaborate with global teams and provide regular reporting to senior management.
* Support hiring and build\-out of the local operations function.


**Requirements**
* Proven track record of operations experience in financial services, fintech, or VASP.
* Experience in a regulated environment with ownership of operational controls, policies and procedures.
* Working knowledge of trading operations, payments, or client\-facing operations workflows.
* Familiarity with the UAE regulatory landscape, particularly VARA requirements, is strongly preferred.
* Ability to meet VARA fit and proper requirements.
* UAE resident or national,UAE\-based or able to relocate.
* Strong interpersonal communication and stakeholder management skills across internal teams, regulators and external partners.

Our client is a leading FMCG manufacturer with a portfolio of well\-established brands operating across multiple channels and markets.  **.**

* Develop and execute the company's commercial strategy in line with overall business objectives.
* Drive sustainable growth in revenue, market share, and profitability.
* Lead and develop high\-performing sales and commercial teams.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, distributors, retailers, and strategic partners.
* Negotiate major commercial agreements and long\-term customer partnerships.
* Identify new business opportunities, routes to market, and growth channels.

The successful candidate will be an inspiring people leader, a trusted business partner, and a highly credible commercial professional capable of delivering growth in a dynamic and competitive environment.

 Our client is a multinational IT consulting and digital transformation solutions provider, supporting government entities, telecom operators, and enterprise clients across the Middle East.  We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Country Manager to lead and manage the company's presence within the assigned country. This is a senior leadership role responsible for driving business growth, managing country\-level operations, strengthening client and partner relationships, and ensuring the overall success and profitability of the business within the territory. The Country Manager will report directly to the Group CEO and will be accountable for developing and executing the country strategy, achieving revenue and financial targets, identifying market opportunities, overseeing sales performance, and ensuring successful delivery of projects and services. The role requires a strong balance of commercial leadership, operational oversight, financial accountability, stakeholder management, and people leadership.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders

**Requirements**
* Proven experience in country management, general management, business leadership, or sales leadership

* Experience managing P\&L, budgets, revenue targets, and business performance
* Strong commercial acumen with experience driving sales growth and market expansion
* Ability to build relationships with enterprise clients, partners, and senior stakeholders
* Strong understanding of project delivery, client success, and service operations
* Proven people leadership experience with the ability to build and manage teams
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field; MBA is an advantage

data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



**Are you ready to lead from the front?** 




 Anaplan is on a mission to revolutionise business planning, and our Presales team is the engine of that ambition. We are looking for a visionary and strategic leader to take the helm of our high\-performing Solution Consulting team in the UAE.
 



 This isn't just a management role; it's a chance to be a pivotal member of the EMEA Go\-To\-Market and EMEA Presales leadership teams. You will be the architect of our regional success, empowering a team of up to 8 brilliant individuals to push boundaries, challenge the status quo, and drive customer success. If you thrive in a culture that embraces diverse perspectives and rewards bold ideas, we want to hear from you.
 



**Your Impact** 




 You won't just be managing a team; you'll be building a legacy. As a business partner to our sales leaders, you will:
 


* **Shape the Vision:** 
  Craft and execute a winning regional strategy for the Solution Consulting team, aligning your vision with our EMEA and global goals.
* **Drive Transformational Change:** 
 Act as a change agent, driving operational excellence and transforming the Germany Solution Consulting team to new heights of performance and agility.
* **Master the Business:** 
  Take ownership of the regional Book of Business, ensuring tight account alignment and accountability across your team to maximise our impact.
* **Lead with Agility:** 
  Proactively partner with regional sales teams to strategically allocate Presales resources, pivot engagement strategies, and drive a winning momentum.
* **Build a World\-Class Team:** 
  Be a magnet for top talent. You will hire, mentor, and develop a team of high\-readiness professionals, defining clear career paths to foster retention and growth.
* **Forge Key Relationships:** 
 Make a direct impact on our UKI business by building unshakeable trust and credibility with key stakeholders at our most strategic customers and partners.



**Your Qualifications** 




 You are a leader who can both strategise from 30,000 feet and execute flawlessly on the ground. You bring:
 


* **Deep Domain Expertise:** 
  Hands\-on knowledge of SaaS applications.
* Specific experience in EPM/CPM\-based technologies, preferably around FP\&A or Supply Chain platforms (preferred).
* **Proven Presales Leadership:** 
  Demonstrable experience managing and inspiring a team of individual Presales contributors while navigating a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales environment. Ideally you will have grown and managed a team in the region.
* **Regional Experience:** 
 A track record of successfully managing a team in UAE or the middle East.
* **A Change\-Maker's Mindset:** 
  You have led teams through transformation and are comfortable driving and managing change.
* **A Player\-Coach Mentality:** 
  The ability to both lead and execute, rolling up your sleeves to help your team win.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



 If you're ready to make your mark and lead a team at the forefront of business transformation, let's talk.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale
 



  





**Area of Responsibility** 




 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership
 



  





**What is Important for This Role** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality
 



 — knows how to build controllable operations
 



 — is capable of building discipline and standards
 



 — can operate in the complex field reality of emerging markets
 



 — can simultaneously manage people, processes, and risks
 



  





 If you know how to build a controllable after\-sales infrastructure in environments where processes on paper and processes in reality are two different things, we would like to speak with you.

**Job Role** 




 The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for a diversified Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight, and Warehousing business. The role is responsible for driving sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence, business expansion, and organizational transformation while ensuring the achievement of short\- and long\-term strategic objectives.
 



  





 The CEO will oversee all aspects of the business, including commercial operations, supply chain management, logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing, financial performance, customer experience, people leadership, and business development. The successful candidate will play a critical role in expanding market presence, identifying new growth opportunities, and strengthening the organization's position as a leading logistics solutions provider.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& Corporate Direction** 



* Develop and execute the company's long\-term vision, growth strategy, and business plans.
* Lead the organization in achieving sustainable growth, profitability, and competitive advantage.
* Identify emerging industry trends, market opportunities, and potential risks impacting the business.
* Drive innovation, digital transformation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish strategic objectives and ensure alignment across all departments and business units.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, government entities, and industry leaders.



  





**Business Growth \& Expansion** 



* Identify new business opportunities, markets, and revenue streams.
* Lead market expansion initiatives across local, regional, and international markets.
* Evaluate acquisitions, partnerships, joint ventures, and strategic alliances to support growth objectives.
* Develop and implement commercial strategies to increase market share and strengthen competitive positioning.
* Drive customer acquisition, retention, and overall business development initiatives.



  





**Operational Excellence** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end logistics, shipping, warehousing, and supply chain operations.
* Ensure efficient utilization of assets, resources, infrastructure, and technology platforms.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, service quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure operational performance meets established KPIs, service levels, and customer expectations.
* Drive best\-in\-class safety, quality, and compliance standards across the organization.



  





**Financial Management \& Governance** 



* Lead the development and execution of annual budgets, business plans, and financial forecasts.
* Ensure achievement of revenue, profitability, and cash flow objectives.
* Optimize working capital, asset utilization, and overall financial performance.
* Monitor business performance and implement corrective actions when required.
* Present business performance, strategic plans, and key initiatives to the Board and stakeholders.
* Ensure sound corporate governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.



  





**Leadership \& People Management** 



* Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing executive leadership team.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and customer focus.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development programs.
* Drive organizational effectiveness and workforce planning initiatives.
* Promote employee engagement, diversity, and a strong performance\-driven culture.
* Mentor senior leaders and ensure the organization attracts and retains top talent.



  





**Customer \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Strengthen relationships with key clients and strategic partners.
* Drive customer\-centric strategies to improve client satisfaction and long\-term business growth.
* Represent the organization at industry forums, conferences, and strategic business engagements.
* Build the company's reputation and brand presence within the logistics and shipping industry.



  





**Risk Management \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable local and international regulations governing shipping and logistics operations.
* Establish effective risk management frameworks and business continuity plans.
* Oversee ESG, health, safety, environmental, and quality initiatives across the organization.
* Implement policies and controls to safeguard company assets and reputation.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 



* Master's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* Executive leadership certifications and professional memberships are advantageous.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 20\+ years of progressive experience within Shipping, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, Transportation, Port Operations, or related sectors.
* Minimum 5\-10 years in a CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Business Unit Head, or equivalent executive leadership role.
* Demonstrated success in scaling businesses, driving profitability, and leading organizational transformation.
* Experience managing large\-scale, multi\-site, or multi\-country operations is highly desirable.
* GCC/UAE experience preferred.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic Vision \& Business Acumen
* Executive Leadership
* Commercial \& Financial Management
* Business Development \& Expansion
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Expertise
* Stakeholder \& Relationship Management
* Corporate Governance
* Change Management \& Transformation
* Decision\-Making \& Problem Solving
* Negotiation \& Influencing Skills
* Risk Management
* Customer\-Centric Leadership



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Visionary and entrepreneurial leader.
* Results\-oriented with a strong commercial mindset.
* Highly proactive and resilient.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Able to lead through change and drive business transformation.
* High integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

data.jd_text:
Our client is a well\-established Hong Kong\-based regulated securities brokerage firm with core expertise in Hong Kong \& US equities trading, serving institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth individuals across Asia. With a fully SFC\-licensed Hong Kong headquarters, they are accelerating global expansion and prioritizing the Middle East as their key strategic growth market. To lead our ground\-up market entry, they are hiring a seasoned executive to serve as our Chief Operating Officer for the Middle East region, reporting directly to the Group CEO in Hong Kong.
 



  





 Location: Long\-term base in UAE, regular Hong Kong HQ alignment.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 As the regional COO for Middle East, you will act as the core executive driving our full market launch across DIFC / ADGM. Your
 **\#1 critical mandate is end\-to\-end ownership of securing a securities brokerage license from DFSA or FSRA** 
 , enabling our regulated offering of HK \& US stock brokerage services in the UAE. You will oversee full greenfield setup of the Middle East office, build and lead the local cross\-functional team, own all regional daily operations, and maintain seamless cross\-regional alignment with our Hong Kong headquarters.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Regulatory Licensing \& Compliance

data.jd_text:
**Role: Director of Engineering \- Platform \| eVTOL Aerospace** 




**Location: Dubai \- Tax\-Free** 




**Working Arrangement: Office based** 




**Salary: Salary details available on application** 




  





 Most senior engineering roles are about maintaining something someone else built.
 



  





 This one isn't.
 



  





 We've just come off a briefing with the leadership team of one of the most ambitious aerospace programmes in the world right now, and we need to talk to you. Because if your career has been building towards a moment where you get to stand something up from scratch \- a genuinely novel aircraft, a founding team of world\-class domain engineers, a programme with the kind of commercial backbone that most ventures can only dream about \- this might be it.
 



  





 What is it?
 



 A Director of Engineering \- Platform role on a confidential eVTOL programme based in Dubai South. The aircraft is a next\-generation electric platform designed to deliver life\-saving emergency response capability. Novel configuration. Genuinely unsolved engineering problems. And a mission that, unlike a significant chunk of what the aerospace industry produces, is unambiguously good for the world.
 



  





 The company is both OEM and operator \- they will certify the aircraft and operate a fleet at scale. That combination essentially doesn't exist anywhere else in the industry today. And they're doing it under a 20\-year sovereign customer agreement, which gives this programme the kind of forward visibility that venture\-backed eVTOL companies simply cannot offer.
 



  





 What does the role involve?
 



 You will own engineering operations for the Platform stream. That means building the team, running the technical maturity cadence, managing the gate review rhythm, allocating resources across the domain Chief Engineers, and keeping the programme moving from early architecture through to certification and production. You sit alongside the Chief Engineer \- Platform as an equal counterpart, and you report directly to the CTO.
 



  





 This is not a technical design role. It is a programme execution and people leadership role. The CE decides what gets built. You make sure it gets built.
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



 Someone who has led teams of serious engineers \- Chief Engineers or equivalent \- on certified civil aerospace programmes. Someone who has built an engineering organisation in the early stages of a complex programme, not just joined one that was already running. Someone who is comfortable with greenfield ambiguity and thrives in it rather than tolerating it.
 



  





 If you have spent your career in mature OEM programmes with hundreds of engineers and a decades\-old process framework, this will feel different. That's not a warning \- it's a filter. The people who've already joined this programme left very senior roles at very large companies to do it. They did it because the scale of the challenge and the quality of the mission was worth it.
 



  





 The package
 



 Tax\-free in Dubai. Relocation package included. Senior leadership level. Salary details available on application.
 



  





 A note on the location
 



 Dubai South is adjacent to Al Maktoum International Airport \- one of the most significant aviation infrastructure developments in the world. If you have always wanted to be somewhere that takes aerospace seriously, this is it.
 



  





 If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been waiting for, apply now or reach out directly. We screen every applicant personally \- no AI filters.
 



  





 We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to treating all applicants with dignity and respect, regardless of background.

**Overview Of The Role:**
 The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing the successful delivery of a single large\-scale construction project, ensuring it aligns with the Project Director’s objectives and organizational strategic goals. The role demands adherence to budget, timeline, and quality standards within a complex and high\-stakes environment. It involves managing multi\-disciplinary teams, navigating regulatory requirements, and fostering effective stakeholder communication to achieve a high standard of project delivery.  Leadership and Team Coordination

* Recruit, motivate, and retain qualified team members, fostering high performance and accountability within the project team.
* Cultivate a collaborative culture, encouraging open communication and proactive problem\-solving.

 Client and Stakeholder Management

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
