data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 
 Design Design LLC, founded in Dubai, United Arab Emirates in 1998, is a leading interior design firm specializing in professional design consultation, contracting, and turnkey projects. The company’s multi\-national team has delivered a wide range of projects, including offices, hotels, lounges, banks, educational institutes, restaurants, retail spaces, and high\-end residential villas. Design Design LLC focuses on creating meaningful design concepts tailored to client requirements and needs. Detailed specifications and meticulous planning before construction support strong project management, cost control, quality assurance, and timely delivery. The firm offers services ranging from the design of select elements to complete turnkey solutions, making it a prominent player in the region’s interior design industry.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Project Manager role based in Dubai. The Project Manager will oversee interior design and turnkey projects from concept through completion, coordinating design teams, contractors, and suppliers to meet project scope, schedule, and budget. Responsibilities include planning project timelines, managing resources, monitoring construction progress, and ensuring adherence to detailed specifications and quality standards. The role involves tracking deliverables, resolving issues, conducting site inspections, and maintaining clear communication with clients and stakeholders. The Project Manager will also prepare reports, support cost control efforts, and contribute to continuous improvement of project management processes.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Project Management skills, including planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication.
* Candidates should possess Expeditor and Expediting skills to ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials and services.
* Candidates should possess Inspection skills to verify work quality, compliance with specifications, and adherence to safety standards.
* Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to manage schedules, supply chains, and site operations efficiently.
* Relevant experience in interior design, construction, or fit\-out projects, preferably within the UAE or GCC region.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools and MS Office; familiarity with design or CAD software is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic skills are a plus.



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Project Planning \& Execution:** 
 Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets, ensuring alignment with client expectations and company objectives.
* **Client Management:** 
 Serve as the main point of contact for clients, addressing concerns, providing updates, and ensuring satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Manage and coordinate designers, engineers, site supervisors, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution.
* **Quality Control \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure all work meets industry standards, project specifications, and Dubai regulations.
* **Budget \& Cost Management:** 
 Monitor expenses, negotiate with suppliers, and implement cost\-effective solutions to maximize profitability.
* **Risk Management:** 
 Identify potential risks and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* **Progress Monitoring \& Reporting:** 
 Track project milestones, prepare progress reports, and present updates to senior management.
* **Site Supervision:** 
 Conduct regular site visits to oversee work progress, enforce safety protocols, and ensure adherence to project deadlines.

data.jd_text:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Director Experience and Operational Excellence you will lead talabat's end\-to\-end experience function across four pillars — Customer Experience, Partner Experience, Fraud Operations, and CX Insights — spanning 8 markets in MENA. You will be accountable for setting and executing multi\-year strategies that drive customer and partner satisfaction, govern multi\-million EUR budgets with direct P\&L impact, and oversee the integrity of the platform through robust fraud governance.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact senior leadership role requiring the ability to operate at both a strategic and executional level — influencing product and commercial roadmaps, shaping cross\-functional policy, and developing a team of senior managers and specialists. You will serve as a key voice in the COO leadership team, championing data\-driven decision\-making, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building world\-class experiences at scale, this role is for you.
   

  

**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?**
**Customer Experience Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own the end\-to\-end CX strategy across all verticals (Food, tMart, Local Shops, DineOut) and 8 MENA markets.
* Define and govern cNPS, cSAT, and other north star metrics — setting targets, driving methodology, and leading cross\-functional execution to move them.
* Translate customer data, behavioral trends, and support signals into prioritized initiatives that improve retention, satisfaction, and order frequency.
* Champion process automation, standardization, and digitalization of key CX workflows.


**Partner Experience \& Budget Governance**
* Oversee talabat's Partner Experience function, ensuring vendor satisfaction (vNPS/vSAT) is treated as a strategic competitive differentiator linked to commercial performance.
* Maintain full accountability for the Functional budgets \- customer and vendor compensation program — a multi\-million EUR annual budget — including annual planning, policy design, market rollout sequencing, and ongoing financial governance.
* Govern the complete portfolio of partner\-facing policies and SOPs across all markets and verticals.


**Fraud Operations \& Risk Governance**
* Provide strategic oversight of talabat's Fraud Operations function, covering prevention, detection, and response frameworks across the ecosystem.
* Ensure fraud governance is aligned with compliance, audit, and legal standards.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment between Fraud, Product, Finance, and Legal to balance risk mitigation with customer experience quality and platform growth.


**Insights \& Analytics**
* Oversee the Insights function, ensuring real\-time visibility into performance across all markets through robust dashboards and structured reporting.
* Champion a data\-first culture across the department — ensuring insights translate into action.
* Partner with BI, Data Science, and Product to build the data infrastructure that underpins reliable departmental performance visibility.
* Run primary research, NPS programs to gather structured, well represented qualitative feedback \- using these to inform local and regional priorities


**People Leadership \& Organisational Development**
* Lead and develop a team of middle managers and specialists and analysts.
* Design the department's OKR framework, KPI architecture, and Business Review structure.
* Set clear goals for the function and drive high performance and professional growth across all levels — fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and customer\-centricity.


**Senior Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Serve as the experience authority in senior leadership forums, influencing Product, Commercial, Finance, and Operations decisions.
* Present strategic insights, budget performance, and departmental OKRs to COO and ExCo leadership.
* Lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional programs assigned at department or company level with no existing playbook.


**Qualifications**
**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Operations, CX, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in customer experience, operations, or strategy, preferably in e\-commerce, food delivery, or a high\-growth tech environment.
* Proven track record of leading mid level managers and large team members across multiple functions in a matrixed organization.
* P\&L or budget accountability, experience ideally at a multi\-million EUR scale.
* Strong background in data analysis, performance management, and CX or operational strategy.
* Experience working across multiple markets and geographies.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional leadership skills — able to inspire, align, and develop high\-performing teams.
* Strategic mindset with strong execution discipline; comfortable operating at both the 30,000\-foot and ground levels.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with the ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to influence and present to ExCo and Board level.
* Deep customer and partner empathy, with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences at scale.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and drive clarity in complex, fast\-moving environments.
* AI\-first mindset — comfortable leveraging automation and emerging tools to drive scale and efficiency.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced AI Business Partner to work in direct partnership with the Property \& Buildings (P\&B) Business Unit leadership. This senior role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and applied intelligence, driving the integration of emerging technologies into core business and project delivery processes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep architectural or engineering expertise with the ability to apply AI, computational design, and digital tools to deliver measurable performance improvements across major programmes.
   

  

 As the single point of accountability for the P\&B AI agenda, you will define priorities, lead delivery, and embed scalable solutions that enhance design quality, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Partnership \& Leadership**
* Act as the dedicated AI Business Partner to P\&B leadership across the Middle East.
* Develop and maintain a clear AI and digital roadmap aligned to business priorities and project demands.
* Provide informed, experience\-led advisory to senior stakeholders on opportunities, risks, and investment decisions.


**Use Case Development \& Value Realisation**
* Identify and prioritise high\-impact use cases across the full project lifecycle—from concept design to delivery.
* Build structured business cases with clear KPIs, ROI, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain a transparent pipeline from opportunity identification through to scaled deployment.


**Computational Design \& Technical Enablement**
* Lead the integration of AI and computational design approaches into project workflows.
* Drive AI adoption within tools including Revit, Dynamo, Rhino, Grasshopper, AutoCAD, and Power BI to support data\-driven design.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within design and engineering teams.


**Delivery \& Change Management**
* Oversee the end\-to\-end implementation of AI solutions within live project environments.
* Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and adopted effectively by multidisciplinary teams.
* Lead change management efforts to embed new ways of working across large programmes.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for AI deployment within P\&B.
* Ensure adherence to WSP standards relating to data security, intellectual property, and risk management.
* Support client engagement on responsible and ethical use of AI technologies.


**Performance Tracking \& Reporting**
* Track and report on performance, benefits, and adoption of AI initiatives.
* Provide clear, executive\-level reporting aligned to business outcomes.
* Continuously refine strategy based on performance insights and evolving requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline; professional accreditation (e.g. RIBA, ARB) is advantageous.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience within a Design Manager, Architect, or equivalent role, delivering large\-scale projects.
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering principles within the built environment.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital, data\-driven, or AI\-enabled solutions within the AEC sector.
* Strong regional experience within the Middle East market.


**Technical Capability**
* Proficiency in BIM and computational design tools (Revit, Dynamo, Grasshopper, Rhino).
* Understanding of data workflows, automation, and emerging AI capabilities within design and engineering contexts.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to Generative AI, advanced analytics, and automation platforms.
* Familiarity with project delivery systems such as P6, Aconex, ACC, and Power BI.
* Experience working within structured enterprise governance environments.
* Background in digital engineering, BIM leadership, or design technology roles.

 QuantaSim is the services arm of Fluid Codes \- the authorized exclusive channel partner of Ansys software, providing simulation software solutions with dedicated customer support across the Middle East since 1997\.
 



 At QuantaSim, we deliver personalized, end\-to\-end engineering simulation solutions designed to tackle your specific engineering challenges.  The Program Manager\- Engineering Training Programs leads the planning and delivery of customer\-focused training programs that accelerate product adoption and strengthen technical capability. This role manages training initiatives linked to product development workflows, ensuring customers gain the knowledge and skills to effectively use advanced engineering and simulation tools. Acting as the central coordination point, the Program Manager collaborates closely with customers, product teams, and technical experts to deliver impactful, well\-structured learning experiences that align with business and technology goals.

  Review project insurance requirements and initiate action to secure coverage in line with contractual obligations.

**The Management Consulting Team at Teneo**
 Our Management Consulting division advises senior leaders on strategic issues that define the success of their organisations. We combine rigorous analysis, commercial judgement and deep sector expertise with the broader capabilities of Teneo to help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.
   

  

 We work across a diverse range of sectors, including Consumer Goods, Healthcare, Leisure \& Hospitality, Software, Transport and Telecom and Digital Infrastructure, amongst others. Within these markets, we provide strategic, operational, and due diligence support, advising FTSE 100 and Fortune 500 companies, key public\-sector organisations, and leading private equity investors.
   

  

  

  

**Key Attributes**
 As a Director, you’ll be a key member of our senior team in Management Consulting team. Your focus will be on delivering exceptional outcomes for clients, while growing and developing our team. Working closely with Senior Managing Directors, you will establish and nurture client relationships, contribute to business development activities, and support the continued growth of the practice.
   

  

 You will be an ambitious and commercially minded leader with experience advising senior executives on complex business challenges. You will bring a track record of delivering high\-impact engagements, building trusted relationships, and leading high\-performing teams across a range of strategic, operational and organisational topics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Structure and lead complex projects, working directly with a Managing Director
* Demonstrate a strong consulting skill set, leading complex analytical programmes, generating insight\-driven recommendations for clients, and producing high quality written deliverables
* Develop recommendations from initial hypothesis through to refinement and validation with senior colleagues and clients
* Lead case teams on a day\-to\-day basis, including workload planning, delegation, coaching and development of junior colleagues
* Lead and support business development activities, including identifying opportunities with existing and prospective clients, developing thought leadership, preparing proposals, and participating client pitches
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor and ensuring the successful delivery of client engagements. Build lasting relationships beyond the scope of individual project engagements.
* Lead client presentations and workshops, communicating complex ideas clearly and effectively to senior audiences


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in any discipline
* 10\+ years’ relevant experience in a Strategy, Management Consulting or a related advisory environment
* Demonstrated experience leading complex client engagements and major strategic programmes
* Proven track record of leading consulting teams and delivering high\-quality client outcomes
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and quantitative skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and relationship\-building skills
* Experience developing and managing senior client relationships
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including coaching and developing junior colleagues
* Strong commercial judgement and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Fluency in Arabic
* Entrepreneurial mindset and approach to problem\-solving
* Experience supporting business development activities, including proposal development, thought leadership and client pitches
* Experience working with public sector, or sovereign\-linked organisations
* Entrepreneurial mindset and approach to problem\-solving
* Additional language capabilities at business communication level


  

  

**What We Offer**
 By advancing your career with our team, you'll enjoy unique benefits, including:
   

  

* Challenging and Diverse Projects – Work on high\-impact projects that drive real change for leading organizations across multiple sectors
* Career Growth and Learning – Build your career alongside experienced professionals that will support your development complemented by structured training programmes
* International Exposure – Gain exposure to global business challenges with opportunities to work on international projects across the region and across our offices
* An Entrepreneurial Environment – Play a key role in shaping the growth, culture and future direction of a fast\-growing practice, office and team
* Competitive Compensation – Benefit from a highly competitive compensation package, with opportunities for performance\-based bonuses and additional benefits


  

  

**About Teneo**
 Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.
   

  

 Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand\-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organisations.
   

  

 Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.
   

  

 The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50\+ offices around the world.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

**Your mission**

 Working closely with the Director of Event Production BU and the wider leadership team, the Project Director will translate the business plans into actionable initiatives, ensure targets are met, maintain and expand client relationships, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.
   

  

 The role also requires close collaboration with other Project Directors across the organisation to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and collective progress toward shared goals.
   

  

 This position reflects our new structure of appointing Project Directors with defined focus areas (e.g., KSA, UAE, Special Projects Global), ensuring scalability and dedicated leadership as our business continues to expand.

* Provide vision, direction, and leadership for project management team.

* Establish clear objectives, OKRs, and performance standards for the Event Production project portfolio.
* Coordinate and collaborate with other Project Directors to ensure alignment of strategies, processes, and delivery standards across all focus areas.
* Drive efficiency, best practices, and continuous improvement in project delivery.
* Mentor, motivate, and support project managers, building a scalable structure that fosters accountability and innovation.

We are looking for top talent, and your success is our succes
data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent, and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To manage and grow relationships with large and strategic clients within the assigned portfolio in the Retail \& Consumer Goods segment of Wholesale Banking. Drive new business origination while ensuring full compliance with Credit and Risk frameworks. Improve service quality levels and supervise the day‑to‑day activities and client interactions of subordinates to ensure the team consistently meets its objectives and achieves revenue targets, while maintaining strong client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. Promote effective cross‑functional collaboration to deliver integrated financial solutions. Achieving financial targets and strategic objectives will be essential in driving sustainable growth and maintaining profitability.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to execute deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Draft Term Sheets, Information Memorandums, Mandate letters etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions.
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields and sufficient ancillary business.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring quality service and effective resolution of issues.
* Prepare briefing note memos ahead of senior management meetings with clients.
* Engage with internal stakeholders to obtain approvals for client RFPs in a timely manner.
* Increase wallet share with existing clients through strategic engagement and product penetration.
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Be knowledgeable on market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Retail \& Consumer Goods team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Present transactions/proposals to the Credit Allocation Committee (CAC) for approvals.
* Run deal RAROCs and draft CAC submissions, ensuring delivery on CAC promises to achieve target RAROC thresholds.
* Prepare Green Light Memos for deal screening and Client Credit Applications (CAs).
* Review CAs and draft relationship comments before submission to Credit Committees.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Address Credit inquiries, liaise with CAD and Legal for documentation matters.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Retail \& Consumer Goods group and Retails \& Wholesale team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short\- \& long\-term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.


- 


**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* CFA, or master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or Investment Banking with exposure to Retail \& Consumer Goods.
* Strong understanding of credit analysis, trade finance, and treasury products.
* Excellent relationship management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage complex client structures and deliver on strategic objectives.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyze and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 
 The Knowledge Society (TKS) is a global innovation program for ambitious teenagers focused on solving real\-world challenges. Over a 10\-month experience, TKS helps students become capable innovators and leaders by engaging with 40\+ emerging technologies and working on impactful projects with organizations like Microsoft, Interac, and the United Nations. The program emphasizes experimentation, building, and creating meaningful solutions rather than memorization, and is designed by leaders from McKinsey, Google, and Stanford to mirror the culture of top startups like SpaceX and DeepMind. Since 2016, TKS has supported more than 4,000 students across 60\+ countries through in\-person and global virtual programs, cultivating a diverse community centered on leadership, growth, and innovation. The organization is rapidly growing and expanding its reach, offering team members the chance to shape the future of youth innovation at scale.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Associate Director role at TKS is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Dubai, UAE. This role is responsible for supporting the Dubai Program Director in delivering the 10\-month TKS program to \~160 students. Our directors have a passion for unlocking potential, want to help make a difference in the world, and have unique backgrounds/experiences.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Program Facilitation:** 
 Collaborate with the Program Director to facilitate the program and deliver engaging weekly sessions to students.
* **Experiential Opportunities:** 
 Design and execute unique, hands\-on learning experiences such as attending conferences, hosting guest speakers, and organizing tours of companies or labs, as feasible.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Serve as a primary point of contact for parents, mentors, and partners, ensuring timely and clear communication to align on program goals and student success.
* **Student Mentorship:** 
 Provide personalized mentorship, guidance, and constructive feedback to accelerate student growth in both project work and personal development.
* **Logistical Support:** 
 Assist the Program Director in managing logistics for unique student experiences, such as conferences, events, guest speaker sessions, and industry or lab tours.
* **Student Recruitment:** 
 Actively recruit driven and high\-potential students by building relationships with schools, leveraging community networks, hosting information sessions, and developing strategic partnerships, alongside reviewing applications and conducting interviews to select the best candidates for the program.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of professional work experience, preferably in education, technology, or program management.
* **Program Expertise:** 
 Experience in implementing and leading engaging programs or initiatives.



  





**Traits:** 




  




* **Passion for Education and Technology:** 
 A deep interest in education, emerging technologies, and cultivating the next generation of leaders and innovators.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and connect with diverse groups of students, stakeholders, and partners.
* **Adaptability:** 
 Ability to adapt, figure things out, and thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

data.jd_text:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Project Director**
**The Company**
 WPP Production is a fast growing division of WPP group. WPP Production is headquartered in London but is present in many markets around the world, working through three global hubs (Singapore, New York and London) and with customer service and production facilities in multiple countries across every continent.
   

  

 WPP Production is an expert provider of marketing communications and advertising production services across Broadcast, Print and Digital media with a full suite of services that can take a creative advertising or promotional concept and deliver it, translated and culturally adapted, in whatever the required medium into every target market in the world, with better turnaround times, higher quality, more functional technology and more effective return on production investment than any competitive offering.
   

  

 Our clients are the world’s leading brands in consumer goods, financial services, automotive and electronics and we therefore compete in markets that demand the absolute highest standards of quality, customer care, reliability and value.
   

  

 Culturally, we seek to combine the entrepreneurial enthusiasm and creativity of an agency start up with the standards and delivery of a world\-class professional services business.
   

  

 We are a culturally diverse organization in a period of transition. We currently have around 2,300 full time employees representing the results of 8 years of continuous growth since start up.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a passionate leader and technical champion for the creation of rich front\-end experiences.
   

  

 You will manage a team of HTML5, Javascript, CSS developers and be ultimately responsible for the clients’ technical delivery.
   

  

 You have an in\-depth knowledge of current and emerging front\-end technologies and can work with server\-side technical leads to create and integrate complex client\-side applications. You will have a clear idea of what ‘good’ looks like, and be able to communicate best practice to your colleagues and fellow project members. You will work with WPP Production and partner organisations to define the optimum technical approach for client projects and ceaselessly promote best practice, quality and craft in your code and the code of those you lead.
   

  

 Strong communication skills, including the ability to listen, understand, advocate, and persuade are essential as you will represent your practice in client and internal senior stakeholder meetings.
   

  

 You will Provide technical thought leadership and promote the vision, strategy and services of the digital department to both educate our teams within Hogarth and to be seen as a leading figure in the industry.
   

  

 Define our distributed development strategy and processes across our onshore, offshore and remote teams, including identifying and developing key strategic technology partnerships.
   

  

 You will manage a team of highly skilled developers ranging from Graduate to Senior level, implementing and maintaining development practices, running meetings and workshops that ensure the growth, motivation and continued development of the team, and ultimately take responsibility for the quality of your team’s output.
   

  

 The team needs to build/modify responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc. based on the visual briefs.
   

  

 You will work closely with other discipline leads (QA/PM) to ensure scoping, estimates, and requirements are estimated correctly and delivered with minimal errors.
   

  

 You must be enthusiastic about technology and constantly be looking at the next innovation. On top of possessing strong oral, interpersonal, and organizational abilities, you must be able to work in a fast paced environment. Flexibility and tolerance is a necessity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Co\-ordinating with leads across key delivery teams (Tech, Project Management, QA, and Resource Management)
* Ensure compliance with WPP production processes
* Acting as the point of escalation for project issues raised by team leads, resolving problems quickly and communicating effectively
* Coaching and developing the team in their roles with regular performance reviews to ensure success in their personal development
* Manage the team hiring and keeping briefs clear and consistently updated
* Interviewing candidates for the team and taking responsibility for the approval of freelancers to work in a fast paced and reactive environment
* Set and manage client expectations while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
* Build strong, trusting relationships with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross\-functional project managers, senior managers, and third\-party vendors that are directly involved with the work
* Manage the approval of quarterly budgets, flagging important budget fluctuations to the client and line manager
* Draft, prepare and present timelines, documents, and presentations and reports both to the client and to the team
* Ensure that the line manager is always aware of all client issues and proposed solutions (including potential delays) to ensure swift resolution and avoid further escalation
* Ensure your account consistently delivers against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
* Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are followed
* Keep GAD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* teamwork, create balanced work schedule and ensure people are able to deliver results
* Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
* Plan resources for overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
* Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters


**Requirements**
* A minimum of 10 years Project Management experience background
* Experience of leading innovation, leveraging emerging platforms and quickly facilitating new ideas and platforms to market
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills
* Know\-how in working cross\-functionally to build relationships between business units, technology, product, media, agency, and design teams
* Experience working on international initiatives \- ideally with exposure to emerging markets
* Self\-motivated and a self\-starter
* Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
* Extensive experience in costing, quotations and project scope definition


* Excellent communication skills to different target groups within the project team, management and clients
* Ensure understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
* Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking
* Pragmatic, team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Understanding of brands and brand challenges
* The ability to function productively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment

* Strong numeracy skills

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

**The Team**
 We are a global, independent, multi\-disciplinary consultancy delivering sustainable engineering and design solutions across the built environment. We are 100% partner\-owned and are proud to have been named Building Magazine’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022, and 2021\.
   

  

 Our data centre team has been leading mission\-critical design since 2006, delivering over 2,000MW of capacity globally. With a reputation for engineering excellence and sustainability, we’ve partnered with some of the world’s most high\-profile clients to create energy\-efficient, low\-emission data centres that set new standards for resilience and innovation. Recognised as Data Centre Consultancy of the Year in 2025, our team continues to push boundaries in design and delivery.
   

  

 Based in Dubai, this role forms a key part of our growing presence across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). You will play a central role in establishing and expanding our regional data centre capability, working collaboratively with our global network and local partners.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced, client\-focused data centre specialist to establish, develop and grow our data centre capability from Dubai, serving clients and projects across the wider MENA region. For the right candidate, this may represent a step up from their current role; they will be supported in making that transition through close collaboration with regional leadership and access to our established global sector experts. The successful candidate will be expected to combine sector credibility, technical leadership and commercial drive to build a sustainable regional business unit.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the sector’s growth and delivery: identifying and mapping priority clients, developing opportunities, leading bids and proposals, shaping project strategies, overseeing multidisciplinary design delivery, and ensuring robust quality assurance and quality control throughout each commission.
   

  

 Working closely with regional leadership and our established global data centre specialists, you will set the direction for the MENA offer, develop trusted client relationships, build a high\-performing local team, and ensure that our technical, commercial and service standards are consistently delivered. You will not be expected to do this in isolation: you will have the support, guidance and technical depth of both the regional leadership team and our global network of sector experts.

* Establish and grow the data centre business unit in Dubai as a regional platform serving the MENA market.
* Develop a clear regional growth plan, including target markets, priority clients, strategic partners, pipeline opportunities and sector positioning.
* Lead work winning activity, including client mapping, opportunity development, bid strategy, proposal leadership, fee development and commercial negotiation.
* Act as a senior client\-facing representative for the data centre sector, building long\-term relationships with developers, operators, hyperscale clients, investors, contractors and delivery partners.

* Own project delivery governance, including programme, resourcing, risk management, change control, commercial performance, reporting and stakeholder communication.

 The role requires someone who can operate as both a sector leader and a delivery lead: commercially aware, technically credible, highly organised, and confident engaging with senior clients, project teams and regional leadership.
   

  

 You will have demonstrable experience developing client relationships, identifying new opportunities, shaping winning proposals and converting prospects into live commissions.  Technically, you will be able to lead and review design outputs, manage multidisciplinary coordination, chair project and design reviews, oversee specifications and reports, and ensure that QA/QC procedures are applied consistently. **Job Purpose**
 At Emirates we believe in connecting the world to and through our global hub in Dubai and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers Fly Better Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology Being pioneers in aviation innovation were always at the forefront pushing boundaries Were on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry Embark on a journey with the worlds largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting edge information and technology team.
   

  

 As an Agile Delivery Lead \- Airline Operations, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end delivery of initiatives that span vendor\-led CAPEX projects, in\-house product enhancements, support releases, and technical debt reduction. You’ll work closely with strategic vendor partners to manage delivery timelines, budgets, and quality \- ensuring that all integrations between vendor\-built systems and Emirates’ enterprise platforms meet our technical and operational standards. You will be expected to drive delivery governance across internal and supplier teams, including dependency management, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, and stakeholder reporting to support programme delivery objectives.
   

  

 The
 **Agile Delivery Lead
 **\- Airline Operations****
 performs the role of Scrum Master, developing and leading a high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary team, instilling in them a clear vision and a passionate drive. They play a leading role in fulfilling the vision, driving the implementation of technical products, and setting standards for teams to follow.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Schedule user stories from the technical product backlog to the Sprint plan, focusing on regular and timely delivery of business value initiatives; facilitates agile ceremonies, e.g., product backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives.
* Manage risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies, removing impediments/blockers to ensure optimal flow of value.
* Guide the team on the use of Agile/Scrum practices and values to delight the business, and how to elicit the most out of self\-organisation. Assess the Scrum Maturity of the team and coach the team to higher levels of maturity, at a pace that is sustainable and comfortable for the team. Promotes empowerment of the team, ensuring that each team member is fully engaged in the initiatives and is making a meaningful contribution, and encourages a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team.
* Work collaboratively with the Technical Product Owners to refine, clarify, and maintain the product backlog; together with the TPO, schedule and commit stories into sprints and visualise progress.
* Support the Technical Product Owners in managing business expectations and transparency in both the product backlog and schedule for all initiatives.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management and effectively manage conflict resolution.
* Ensure the Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done (DOD) are being followed; make sure that each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintains an agile project management tool (ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or similar
* Certified Scrum Master with 3\+ years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline
* PMI ACP
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a small/medium technology change programme.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery, e.g., MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders and vendors.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty, and respect.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.

**We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.**
 We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI\-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals.
   

  

 Our team is small and talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.
   

  

 Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Applied AI Transformation Managers are technically oriented strategic advisors and operators who ensure value alignment to our customer's most strategic projects and drive program delivery across several strategic accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying strategic opportunities for our customers to realize value from Cognition’s platform and ensuring strong value capture and reporting. You will support delivery of enterprise wide programs to implement agentic AI, specifically by designing and building the operating model and delivery model for agentic AI.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to senior and functional leaders, designing value realization targets and delivering transformation programs. This role embeds with a select set of Cognition’s strategic accounts for upfront strategy work through in\-depth program management and delivery. You will be on the frontlines of supporting customers turning productivity gains and quantifiable financial impact. You will pioneer the playbook for how the world’s largest enterprises get value from AI Agents.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Work with customer leadership to identify, quantify and report value targets for productivity gains and financial impact
* Ensure seamless operations and delivery for the overall customer program, in close partnership with the Cognition account team
* Ensure everyone at customer and Cog has visibility on playbook implementation, consumption metrics and value metrics
* Maintain great relationships and customer trust via delivery
* Oversee onboarding and rollout to thousands of engineers, ensuring successful deployment
* Apply world class analytical and technical program management skills to support customer executives and teams, particularly with value realization and tracking
* Build centers of excellence within accounts and empower them through tailored enablement programs


**Requirements For The Role**
* Computer science or EE undergrad
* SWE intern or full time work experience
* 3\-5 years at a big 3 strategy consulting firm with a strong background in value targeting and realization and technology strategy as well as a proven track record building and expanding client relationships
* Ideally 2\+ years experience at a startup in a customer facing role preferred
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments—you move quickly and grow quickly
* Demonstrated ability to learn exceptionally fast


**You might excel if you…**
* have successfully been a part of complex enterprise teams, especially sourcing and managing account growth
* have worked as a software engineer, SE, technical account manager or other technical role
* previously founded a startup or were early stage at a high growth startup
* are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high\-intensity environments


 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

data.jd_text:
**About Us:** 




  





 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries
 **.** 




  





**About this rol** 
 e:
 



  





 We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
 



  





 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat



  





**What success looks like:** 




  





**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
 



**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
 



**By 12 months** 
 : You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**You must have** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data



  





**Bonus if you have** 
 :
 


* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams



  





**This role is for you if...** 



* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought



  





**This role is NOT for you if...** 



* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices



  





 Additional information
 



  





**Your career growth path:** 




 Talabat operates a structured career framework with clearly defined levels for engineering leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, you'll enter an established progression that rewards growing impact, strategic ownership, and people leadership:
 



**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
 



**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
 



**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
 



**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.
