data.jd_text:
We are a global real estate developer with a presence in over 150 offices worldwide and a strong, established footprint across the Middle East. We deliver world\-class residential and commercial developments, driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for creating inspiring spaces. We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Technical Product Manager / Delivery Lead** 
 (Governed Digital \& AI Platform) to join our team in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 We are consolidating its AI and digital products into a single governed enterprise platform: one shared technical spine, a controlled release path, and clear boundaries between the core product, modules delivered by separate teams, and standalone or experimental work.
 



  





 This role owns that platform on the technical side and leads the team that builds it. It is a deliberate hybrid of technical product manager and delivery lead. You set and hold the technical and architectural direction, and you are accountable for delivering it into production and running the engineering team that does the work. It is a hands\-on role, not a coordination seat.
 



  





  





**Reporting and team** 




 Reports to the Head of Strategic Transformation. Leads the platform engineering team (AI engineers, data engineer, graduate developer) and owns its delivery cadence, standards, and growth, including new technical hires. Serves as the technical counterpart to the product managers delivering individual modules, holding the interface contract they build against, and is the single technical owner other teams approach when new work needs a home.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Platform architecture and governance** 



* Own and maintain the platform's solution architecture: one governed spine (authentication, APIs, design system, data schema) consumed across every workstream, with isolation boundaries drawn so a failure in one module never destabilises the platform.
* Define and enforce the interface contract that separately built modules must meet before entering any shared environment.
* Keep repository, naming, and URL conventions consistent across the estate so it stays legible and maintainable as it scales.



**Release and deployment** 



* Run the promotion path across Development, UAT, and Production with defined gate criteria at each stage, so nothing reaches production unreviewed.
* Manage batched releases of core components, and land externally built modules behind feature flags so a failing module can be switched off without downtime.
* Migrate the platform from local development into COMPANY's managed environment and keep the deployment pipeline automated and repeatable rather than manual.



**Integration and forward delivery** 



* Onboard incoming modules through contract compliance, integration testing, and a defined graduation gate, protecting the core release cycle throughout.
* Own the forward technical roadmap: scope, sequence, and deliver new capability, and decide what becomes a core release, an integrated module, or a retired experiment.



**Team leadership and delivery** 



* Line\-manage the engineering team: set sprint cadence, review architecture and code, uphold quality and security standards, and develop the team as it grows.
* Remain technical enough to work in the codebase, make architecture decisions, and unblock the team directly.



**Governance and assurance** 



* Ensure every capability that supports live client work is auditable, access\-controlled, and defensible, consistent with COMPANY's governed\-platform standard.



  





**Essential experience** 



* At least eight years in software delivery, including a minimum of four leading engineering or technical product teams that shipped and operated production systems.
* Proven ownership of a multi\-environment deployment lifecycle (Development, UAT, Production), CI/CD, feature flagging, and release governance on a live product.
* A hands\-on engineering background: able to read and review code, reason about API and data\-schema design, and make architecture decisions, not only coordinate those who do.
* Direct line management of developers, including setting standards and running delivery cadence.
* Experience integrating independently built modules into a shared platform without destabilising it, using interface contracts, versioning, and isolation.



**Technical competencies** 



* Modern web application architecture, API design, and data modelling.
* Cloud deployment and environment management; infrastructure\-as\-code and pipeline automation an advantage.
* Working fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling, including Claude Code, and comfort operating an application stack backed by large language models (model routing, prompting, guardrails).
* Version control, branching strategy, and code review at team scale.



**Desirable** 



* Exposure to the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) sector, or a computational design background.
* Experience deploying enterprise AI under governance, audit, or regulatory constraint.
* A record of establishing canonical project and configuration conventions across multiple repositories.



**First\-year outcomes** 



* The platform is fully migrated to the managed environment with a documented, repeatable deployment pipeline.
* The interface contract is published and every new module onboards through it, with no integration destabilising the core platform.
* The Development, UAT, and Production promotion path operates on defined gates with no unreviewed production releases.
* The engineering team runs a predictable release cadence, with new technical hires productive.
* Agreed module deliveries are integrated on schedule against the roadmap.



  





**Scope note:** 




  





 This is a hybrid technical product manager and delivery lead role. Product prioritisation and stakeholder alignment are part of it, but the core accountability is technical: architecture, deployment, governance, and the delivery team. It is not a portfolio\-management or purely coordinating position.

data.jd_text:
Executive Assistant — Middle East
 **(Maternity Cover)**




  





***About the Role***




 This is an exciting opportunity to join a
 **top\-tier international law firm** 
 in a key role within its Middle East team. The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East, bringing substantial EA experience gained within an international law firm based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
 



  





 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
 



  





***Roles and Responsibilities***




  





**Executive Support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Proactively manage the Head's complex, high\-volume diary, scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Act as gatekeeper, triaging meeting requests, queries and issues, and redirecting them appropriately while ensuring matters are resolved effectively.
* Prepare agendas, attend meetings the Head is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and follow up with action owners to ensure timely completion.
* Attend meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head where appropriate, independently managing follow\-up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
* Prepare briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to support strategic and commercial decision\-making.
* Anticipate information needs and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams ahead of key meetings or decisions.



  





**Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation** 



* Arrange end\-to\-end complex travel, including multi\-destination international itineraries, transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
* Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction\-specific requirements.
* Provide strategic input into travel planning, combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
* Liaise with colleagues across offices and functions to ensure a joined\-up, firm\-wide approach that maximises the value of each trip.
* Manage last\-minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently.
* Prepare detailed post\-trip reports covering meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities and next steps, and ensure all follow\-up actions are diarised and progressed.



  





**Marketing \& Business Development Support** 



* Manage speaking engagements and thought\-leadership commitments, tracking deadlines, coordinating research, and drafting materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
* Arrange briefing meetings ahead of panels, speaking slots or publications to ensure the Head is fully prepared.
* Liaise with the Knowledge team and internal stakeholders to obtain research and background material, ensuring contributions are accurate and high quality.
* Register the Head for events and prepare comprehensive pre\-event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives.
* Work with the Head and Business Development teams to maintain up\-to\-date client target lists, tracking status and ensuring assigned actions are progressed.
* Provide regular status updates on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against objectives.



  





**Billing, Finance \& Expenses** 



* Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head's matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
* Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance, and issue final invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
* Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head.
* Oversee expense submissions, liaising directly with vendors to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where needed.
* Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget\-holder approval in line with firm policy.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding invoices and payments, keeping the Head and the Billing and Finance teams fully informed.



  





**Performance \& People Processes** 



* Support the Head throughout the performance review process, scheduling review meetings in line with firm\-wide deadlines.
* Prepare review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
* Monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
* Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head during discussions.
* Support completion of post\-meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, and maintain oversight of outstanding actions.
* Maintain close, regular communication with HR throughout the review cycle, confirming deadlines and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.



  





**CRM \& Relationship Management** 



* Maintain and update the Head's contacts and relationship data in InterAction, accurately recording activities, meetings and notes.
* Support the Head in managing effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers across jurisdictions.
* Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring they are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
* Ensure referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow\-up on agreed actions and opportunities.



  





**Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison** 



* Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and updating the Head regularly.
* Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations) to ensure strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of regional initiatives.
* Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings to keep all functions informed, aligned and engaged, agreeing deliverables and capturing activities, deadline changes and requirements for the Head's radar.
* Ensure key outputs feed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings.



  





**Person Specification** 



* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or in a similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi\-time\-zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
* Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi\-destination itineraries, visas and short\-notice changes.
* Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparing draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
* Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
* Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
* Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to draft correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
* Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
* Professional, client\-focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior stakeholders and clients.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

Meydan Free Zone offers entrepreneurs and start\-up businesses the opportunity to set up and run their own businesses right in the heart of Dubai. We provide access to exceptional talent, entrepreneur expertise, and a wide range of start\-up support services.
 



  





 As we continue our exciting growth plans, we seek talented people to join us. We are currently hiring a dynamic
 **Assistant Manager \- Client Servicing** 
 who will support the Head, Client Servicing in overseeing daily operational activities. This role focuses on driving operational efficiency, ensuring regulatory compliance, improving service delivery, and building team capability through structured training and performance monitoring. The ideal candidate is an Arabic speaker with a proven track record of optimizing processes through data\-driven reporting and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Operations Management** 



* Support end\-to\-end operations for business licensing and UAE residence visa processing (GDRFA), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with Free Zone and government regulations.
* Monitor daily workloads, case progress, SLAs, and turnaround times; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders, if needed (GDRFA, Free Zone authorities, typing centers, medical/Emirates ID partners, Third Party Authorities) to ensure smooth processing.



  





**Process Improvement \& Efficiency** 



* Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives using Six Sigma/Lean methodologies to enhance efficiency, reduce errors, and improve customer experience.
* Document, review, and standardize SOPs, workflows, and checklists across licensing and visa operations.
* Track KPIs and operational metrics; recommend corrective actions based on trend analysis and root cause findings.



  





**Reporting \& Analytics** 



* Prepare accurate and timely operational reports (daily/weekly/monthly) covering volumes, TAT, compliance, rework rates, and productivity to support management decision\-making and capacity planning.



  





**Training \& People Development** 



* Design and deliver structured onboarding and refresher training programs for operations staff.
* Conduct process briefings, quality clinics, and coaching sessions to uplift team capability and consistency.
* Support performance reviews by providing feedback and improvement plans.



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 



* Ensure adherence to Free Zone regulations, Third\-Party Authorities, GDRFA requirements, and internal policies.
* Conduct internal audits and quality checks; implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Stay updated on regulatory changes and translate updates into operational guidance and training materials.



  





**Customer Experience** 



* Support escalation handling and resolution of complex cases to ensure high customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales and customer service teams to align expectations, documentation requirements, and timelines.

* Bachelor’s degree required in an education\-related field or Business Administration, or relevant experience within a legal\-related company or industry (e.g., Education, Training, Instructional Design, Educational Management, Business Administration, Law, Legal Studies, or similar).

* Experience in reporting, data analysis, and performance management.

* Training and facilitation skills; comfortable delivering structured learning sessions.
* High attention to detail and strong compliance orientation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, regulated environment.



  





**Language skills:** 



* English.

Working alongside the Regional Head of Site Services, you'll play a key role in developing our regional business, strengthening client relationships and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.
 



 If you're passionate about leadership, enjoy building successful teams and want to make a tangible impact on a growing international consultancy, we'd love to hear from you.
 



 What you'll be doing

* Lead, mentor and develop Regional and Area Site Services Leads, building a collaborative and high\-performing culture.
* Drive operational excellence across multiple projects, ensuring consistent standards, governance and best practice.

* Deputise for the Regional Head of Site Services when required, representing the business across internal and client\-facing activities.



 What's in it for you
 


* A senior regional leadership role with genuine influence over business performance and strategy.
* The opportunity to lead multidisciplinary teams delivering complex, high\-profile engineering projects.
* Exposure to international clients and mission critical developments.
* A collaborative environment where leadership, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged.
* Career progression within one of the fastest\-growing engineering consultancies in the data centre sector.
* The chance to shape regional standards, mentor future leaders and contribute to the long\-term success of the business.

* Strong commercial awareness with experience managing budgets, financial performance and operational delivery.

 Apply today or contact us for a confidential conversation.

data.jd_text:
**Job title: Head of Feasibility** 




**Reports to VP Development** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 The Head of Feasibility is responsible for leading the feasibility and market intelligence function across United Hospitality Management's hotel development pipeline. The role evaluates new hotel management, acquisition, lease, investment and development opportunities by conducting comprehensive market, financial, and operational analyses to support strategic decision\-making.
 



  





 Working closely with the Executive Leadership, Business Development, Operations, Finance and Asset Management teams, the Head of Feasibility provides data\-driven recommendations that determine the commercial viability of projects across entire United Hospitality Management target markets.
 



  





**Duties and Responsibilities** 




**1\. Feasibility \& Market Analysis** 



* Lead the preparation of hotel feasibility studies for new developments, conversions, acquisitions, leases and management opportunities.
* Evaluate market demand, supply, competitive landscape, and future market trends.
* Analyze destination performance, tourism drivers, accessibility, and economic indicators.
* Assess the suitability of proposed hotel locations, positioning, and brand opportunities.



**2\. Financial Analysis \& Deal Underwriting** 



* Develop detailed financial models, including:
* Revenue projections
* Departmental operating statements
* GOP and EBITDA forecasts
* Cash flow projections
* Investment returns (IRR, NPV, ROI) – where applicable
* Sensitivity and scenario analyses
* Prepare investment memorandums and business cases for executive approval.
* Evaluate project risks and recommend mitigation strategies.



**3\. Hotel Development Support** 



* Support the Business Development team in evaluating potential hotel management contracts and acquisitions.
* Provide commercial recommendations during negotiations with hotel owners and investors.
* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, and development pitches.
* Assist where required with deal board approval submission papers.
* Participate to internal \& external aspects of the development process including conferences, client meetings and networking opportunities as and when required.



**4\. Strategic Research \& Market Intelligence** 



* Monitor hospitality market trends, pipeline developments, tourism statistics, and macroeconomic indicators.
* Produce regular market intelligence reports for senior management.
* Identify emerging markets and new development opportunities aligned with UHM's expansion strategy.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with:
* Business Development
* Operations
* Revenue Management
* Finance
* Asset Management
* Design \& Technical Services
* Ensure feasibility assumptions are aligned with operational realities and company standards.



**6\. Leadership \& Quality Assurance** 



* Lead and mentor the feasibility team.
* Establish best practices, methodologies, and reporting standards.
* Ensure all studies are accurate, commercially sound, and delivered within agreed timelines.
* Continuously improve feasibility tools, financial models, and analytical processes.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Timely completion of feasibility studies
* Accuracy of financial forecasts and assumptions
* Quality and reliability of market intelligence
* Support provided to successful hotel signings and acquisitions
* Executive satisfaction with analysis and recommendations
* Continuous improvement of feasibility methodologies



  





**Key Requirements** 



* Excellent command of spoken and written English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with strong financial modeling capabilities.
* In\-depth knowledge of hotel valuation methodologies and feasibility analysis.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Real Estate, Business Administration or a related field. An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is highly preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in hotel feasibility and development with an international or global hotel group.
* Demonstrated exposure to and experience across the European, Middle Eastern, African, and Asian (EMEA \& Asia) hospitality markets.
* Strong analytical, commercial, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to assess investment opportunities and support business growth.



  





**Others** 



* Perform other duties as assigned by management to support the overall objectives of the management team.
* Complies with all the company’s policies and procedures.
* Working hours as required to do your job but normally not less than 48 hours per week.

data.jd_text:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview**
 BlackRock Aladdin business is uniquely positioned to address the industry’s investment management and financial technology demands. The various business departments within Aladdin entity are focused on providing clients with highly scalable end to end investment management solutions for both Public and Private markets. The Aladdin Client Business (ACB) entity is effectively responsible for growing the Aladdin business with our existing external clients, implementing our solutions and managing the relationship \& services across the lifetime of our clients.
   

  

 The role sits within our Aladdin Client Engagement team that is responsible for expanding our footprint withing our existing client base as well as minimizing churn and providing best in class user experience on our technologies: user adoption, value delivery and client satisfaction are key objectives for our teams. The successful candidate will be an integral part of the Client Engagement team and will assume a Client Relationship Manager position, servicing our clients across a range of activities including relationship management, business development, churn prevention and value delivery. The candidate must have a solid finger pulse of the client’s entire organization and be imbedded into the client’s key Decision Makers and Business leaders to drive adoption and growth. BlackRock as a firm expects significant growth in the Middle East region and the successful candidate will be an integral part of the local team who will be going to make this possible.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and establish strong relationships with clients based in the Middle East and represent all of BlackRock in a compelling fashion.
* Liaise with the clients’ key stakeholders and provide strong leadership for the Aladdin and eFront relationships. Specifically tasked to build senior connectivity within our client base. Develop a strong working relationship with clients to promote adoption of our technologies, including developing training and marketing materials for client use.
* Develop strong relationships with all groups within BlackRock Aladdin and BlackRock to ensure an excellent client experience and convey client requirements to product teams as necessary.
* Work with local Business Development, implementation, and asset management teams to build an integrated single client experience.
* Coordinate with our Support organization and our Product Management \& Engineering organization to provide best service to clients.
* In charge of client management across Public \& Private asset classes
* Clients are large to medium sized SWFs, Asset Managers, Pensions Funds and Family offices
* Manage the relationship with clients with 3 major objectives:
* Expand footprint, prevent revenue attrition and ensure client satisfaction
* Regular travel in the region is required.


**Skills And Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess some combination of all the following:
   

  

* Fluent in English, Arabic is a plus.
* 10 years \+ in the Fintech industry (as a client, in a consulting company, with a technology provider)
* Uncovers and meets the need of external clients; builds strong working partnerships with clients and internal organization; acts with urgency and works hard to address client demands; effectively manages clients’ expectations and delivers value\-added service; Capable to manage client relationship from tactical/operational to strategic.
* Deep knowledge of capital markets – both public and private; she/he understands the business, financial and technical terminology, including how organizations operate, compete, profit and grow. Keeps abreast of developments in own field and considers how this knowledge can be applied.
* Technologically “aware” to be conversant with clients and visualize opportunities. Technology knowledge is important, but a deep skillset is not necessary.
* Demonstrated experience successfully leading strategic initiatives within a global organization.
* Committed to gaining relevant knowledge, skills and experience in commercial markets; utilizes market expertise and savvy to leverage this role; stays passionate about the business and maintains current knowledge about competitor products and services.
* Strong project management, coordination, problem solving/analytical thinking.
* Superior communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts simply and clearly to clients. Capable of connecting with multiple audiences and articulating lines of reasoning
* Ability to operate as a self\-starter, operating with limited guidance in a highly matrixed organization.
* Enjoy a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment; able to manage multiple priorities.
* Proven track record in managing clients (harvesting, churn, client satisfaction)
* Comfortable working in diverse and multi\-cultural environment
* Used to manage her/his business and report with data \& analytics


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well\-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock \| Twitter: @blackrock \| LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

 The Company is establishing a dedicated investment platform focused on AI\-native technology companies serving the global real estate industry. **Investment origination and execution** 



* Build and maintain a high\-quality, proprietary deal pipeline across Global and Asian markets, leveraging personal networks, ecosystem partners and the Company's operating relationships.
* Develop sub\-sector theses and target maps across PropTech, ConstructionTech, FinTech\-for\-Real\-Estate, hospitality technology and AI infrastructure.

**Strategy, ecosystem and brand**

* Represent the fund externally at industry forums and within the Asian PropTech and AI ecosystems.



**LP and stakeholder engagement** 



* Contribute to LP reporting, capital calls, AGMs and ad\-hoc investor communications.
* Support fundraising activities, including pipeline showcases and reference calls.
* Coordinate with the Company parent organisation on strategic alignment, pilot opportunities and reporting.



  





**Required Experience and Qualifications** 




**Mandatory** 



* Minimum 10 years' experience in private equity, venture capital, growth equity or institutional asset management at a credible firm with a verifiable track record.

* Direct experience leading a fund, sleeve, region or thematic strategy (or co\-leading a recognised investment programme), with accountability for capital deployment and portfolio outcomes.

**Highly desirable** 



* Prior experience investing in PropTech, ConstructionTech, FinTech\-for\-Real\-Estate or vertical SaaS.
* Experience working with corporate or strategic LPs in a hybrid financial / strategic vehicle.
* Operating, founding or senior commercial experience within a technology company.
* Working knowledge of Mandarin, Japanese or Korean.
* MBA or CFA from a leading institution; strong undergraduate degree from a recognised university.



  





**Sector and Technical Knowledge** 



* Deep understanding of the AI and SaaS landscape, including AI\-native architectures, data moats, agentic systems, go\-to\-market models, retention dynamics and unit economics.

* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks affecting AI deployment, including the EU AI Act, UK and EU GDPR (including Article 22 on automated decisioning), and sector\-specific regimes administered by MAS, HKMA, SFC, FSA, RBI and equivalent Asian regulators.
* Confidence interpreting technical diligence findings on data architecture, model risk, infrastructure dependencies and information security.



  





**Skills and Competencies** 



* Outstanding financial modelling, valuation and structuring skills.
* Excellent commercial and strategic judgement; able to form and defend differentiated views.
* Confident negotiator with credibility at founder, C\-suite and LP levels.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, suitable for IC papers, board memos and LP reports.
* High personal standards, intellectual honesty and a collaborative working style.

**Position Overview**
 Your Role

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Client\-oriented, solution\-oriented and able to work in a high paced environment under pressure

**Strategic KPIs**

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview** 




 The Regional Real Estate Portfolio Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing the Client’s real estate portfolio across the Middle East region. This role ensures strong commercial oversight, governance, and relationship management with landlords and stakeholders while adapting leasing strategies to regional market dynamics, regulatory frameworks, and cultural considerations.
 



 The role requires fluency in Arabic and English to effectively manage negotiations, documentation, and stakeholder engagement across diverse Middle Eastern markets.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Lease Portfolio Oversight:
 


* Manage and maintain an accurate portfolio of lease agreements across multiple Middle Eastern jurisdictions.
* Monitor lease compliance, key terms, and obligations in line with local property laws and practices.
* Provide structured portfolio reporting including rent levels, tenancy terms, and occupancy metrics.



 Invoice and Financial Validation:
 


* Review and validate lease\-related invoices from landlords or property managers.
* Investigate billing discrepancies and coordinate with landlords to ensure corrections are implemented.
* Ensure alignment with agreed commercial terms and local tax considerations (e.g., VAT variations across GCC countries).



*Note: The role does not include authority to process or execute payments.* 




 Critical Date \& Lease Event Management:
 


* Track and manage critical lease dates (renewals, break options, expiries, rent reviews).
* Provide proactive alerts and strategic recommendations to support occupancy and cost decisions.
* Deliver periodic (quarterly) portfolio reviews with regional stakeholders.



 Lease Administration \& Transaction Support:
 


* Coordinate administrative processes related to lease lifecycle events (new leases, amendments, renewals).
* Gather required documentation for internal approvals in line with governance processes.
* Support site acquisition activities where needed, in collaboration with internal teams and external brokers.



 Lease Renewal \& Renegotiations:
 


* Lead lease renewal negotiations with landlords following internal alignment on commercial strategy.
* Benchmark market rental values across key Middle Eastern cities to support decision\-making.
* Negotiate improved commercial terms in response to market conditions, supply\-demand dynamics, or operational needs.
* Provide advisory input on lease terms, considering regional legal frameworks and customary practices.



 Site Exit and Lease Termination Management:
 


* Manage lease exits including notice coordination, landlord engagement, and exit negotiations.
* Coordinate pre\-handover inspections and assess reinstatement obligations in line with lease terms.
* Negotiate exit conditions to minimize financial and operational exposure.



*Note: Execution of physical reinstatement works is outside the scope.* 




 Stakeholder and Relationship Management:
 


* Act as the primary interface with landlords, property managers, and external advisors across the region.
* Support internal stakeholders (finance, legal, operations) on real estate matters.
* Facilitate resolution of disputes, claims, or legal matters in collaboration with internal and external counsel.
* Maintain culturally appropriate and effective communication across diverse markets.
* Build relationships in a relationship\-driven business culture where trust and local presence are critical.



 Facilities Management Coordination:
 


* Manage the contractual side of FM service providers, in coordination with local stakeholders
* Participate in / Animate QBR with key FM service providers
* Suggest action plans when service level deviates from expectations
* Liaise with local teams to gather quality indicators



 Ad hoc Support:
 


* Additional support may be required across the Otis account, if necessary.



  





**Skills \& Experience** 




  





**Essential** 



* Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
* Proven experience in commercial real estate portfolio or lease management (multi\-country preferred).
* Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated ability to deliver commercial value.
* Understanding of Middle East real estate markets and leasing practices.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across different countries and cultures.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience working across GCC countries or wider Middle East region.
* Familiarity with real estate legal frameworks in UAE and neighbouring countries.
* Experience in large corporate or multinational portfolio environments.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management
* Negotiation and influencing
* Attention to detail
* Cultural awareness
* Problem\-solving



  





**Additional Notes** 



* The role requires occasional travel across the Middle East.
* The successful candidate must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-jurisdictional environment.

data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.

data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 178944
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Head of Data Science \& Asset Risk holds a pivotal role within Al\-Futtaim's financial services division, responsible for overseeing analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence. The key purpose is to optimize the company’s automotive and financial services portfolio using data\-driven insights. This role combines financial control, risk management, and analytics leadership to support executive and board\-level decision\-making. Key responsibilities include maintaining market indices and price curves, defining asset risk frameworks, providing risk\-driven inputs to capital planning, and acting as the technical authority on asset valuation and risk. Success is measured by the ability to turn data and AI into explainable, regulator\-ready financial outcomes and to influence strategic decisions that impact P\&L, balance sheet, and return on assets.The position operates at the intersection of CFO\-level financial control, CRO\-level risk management and CDO\-level analytics leadership, supporting executive and Board decision\-making across the group.


**What You Will Do:**
* Own end\-to\-end analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence for the automotive and financial services portfolio.
* Turn data, AI, and market intelligence into financial outcomes that drive pricing, leasing, provisioning, capital allocation, and portfolio strategy.
* Maintain authoritative market indices, price curves, and forward\-looking scenarios for all brands, powertrains, and segments.
* Define and enforce the Asset Risk Framework covering market risk, EV transition risk, concentration risk, and volatility.
* Provide risk\-driven inputs to IFRS9, provisions, ECL, and capital planning.
* Ensure all models are auditable, explainable, and regulator\-ready.
* Act as the single source of truth for portfolio value, forward price risk, stress scenarios, and financial impact of market movements.
* Chair the Residual Value \& Risk Committees and translate complex analytics into clear financial actions for CFO, CRO, and Executive Management.
* Influence vehicle pricing and lease structures, portfolio profitability and risk appetite, provisioning and capital allocation, OEM negotiations, and product launches.
* Own the AI\-driven asset intelligence platform including data pipelines, forecasting, valuation, and risk models.
* Lead a senior team of Data Scientists and Analytics specialists.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Advanced expertise in data science and statistical analysis.
* Proficient in risk management and financial modelling.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills for executive\-level reporting and committee participation.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* 10\+ years of experience in statistics, data science, risk management, pricing, forecasting, or financial modelling.
* Experience in automotive, asset finance, banking, insurance, or management of large portfolios.
* Demonstrated ownership of models crucial to P\&L impact.
* Strong background in IFRS9, ECL, stress testing, or portfolio risk management.
* Comfortable operating at CFO, CRO, and board level interactions.


**About Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
 The real estate development and operations arm of Al\-Futtaim, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high\-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega\-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
   

  

 Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
   

  

 AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Malls**
 Al\-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail\-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al\-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.
   

  

 Part of the Al\-Futtaim Group, Al\-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al\-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.
   

  

 Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al\-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al\-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long\-term value for its partners.
   

  

 For more information on Al\-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al\-futtaimmalls.com/
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies**
 Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

**.**

* Use trade structuring as a source of alpha in its own right
* Build your own scanners and screening tools, pricing large numbers of binary options daily to surface opportunities
* Deliver a decorrelated return profile; lumpy PNL is acceptable provided expected returns are positive and attractive.

* Macro strategist or structuring background at a bank, ideally followed by a successful buy\-side move with some track record.

* Cross\-asset breadth preferred; single\-product specialists (FX, rates, EQD) considered if curious and adaptable.
* Practical tooling capability; deep quant or programming skills not a strict requirement
* Comfortable running a long\-convexity book that is not a tail hedge
* Willing to be based in Dubai



  





 For more information, apply here or contact Tom on tom@qenexus.com

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading sovereign wealth investor to hire a Senior Associate into its Public Markets team. This is a strategic asset allocator seat: the core of the role is selecting, appointing and overseeing best\-in\-class external fund managers across global public markets, rather than managing positions actively on a day\-to\-day basis.
 



  





 The mandate is built around long\-term, strategic allocation of capital through external managers. You will help decide which managers earn the institution's capital, why, and at what size, then monitor that conviction over time. If you enjoy manager due diligence, allocation decisions and patient, research\-led oversight more than running a trading book, this will suit you.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 Reporting to the Head of Public Markets, you will support the full external manager lifecycle across equities, fixed income, liquid alternatives and multi\-asset strategies.
 



  





**What you will focus on:** 




  




* Mapping the investable external manager universe across asset classes, styles and geographies using databases, consultant networks, conferences and industry contacts.
* Screening strategies on performance, risk, factor exposures, drawdowns, liquidity, capacity and fees to shortlist managers for deeper due diligence.
* Leading qualitative and quantitative due diligence, including meetings with portfolio managers, analysts and risk officers, to assess philosophy, process, portfolio construction, alpha drivers and team stability.
* Applying analytics to distinguish genuinely active, skilled managers from market beta, and testing whether fees and compensation are justified.
* Coordinating operational and risk due diligence with risk, legal and compliance teams.
* Preparing manager selection reports and investment memos, and presenting hire / retain / redeem recommendations to investment committees.
* Negotiating mandate terms, fees, performance structures, liquidity terms and side letters to align manager incentives with the institution's objectives.
* Monitoring appointed managers against benchmarks and peers, maintaining conviction ratings, and supporting rebalancing and allocation sizing decisions.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  




* 5–7 years in public markets investing, with a clear emphasis on external manager selection, including Hedge Funds, oversight and monitoring (from a pension fund, consultant, family office, SWF or asset manager).
* Demonstrable hedge fund and liquid alternatives manager selection experience is important for this mandate.
* A genuine orientation toward long\-term, strategic allocation through external funds rather than active, day\-to\-day position management.
* Strong manager research depth: the ability to judge whether a manager's past results are repeatable.
* Solid quantitative evaluation skills across performance, factor/style and risk analysis.
* Structured decision\-making, sound risk awareness and the judgement to make clear hire/retain/terminate calls.
* Confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to defend recommendations to investment committees.
* CFA or an advanced degree in finance, economics or a related field.
* High integrity, a fiduciary mindset and an entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach.



  





**What is on offer:** 




  





 A high\-visibility seat with one of the region's most respected institutional investors, direct exposure to senior decision\-makers and global external managers, and a long\-term, conviction\-led approach to public markets investing, based in Dubai.

 Dubai has become the family office capital of the fastest\-growing wealth corridor in the world. Families are relocating, structures are being rebuilt, capital is being deployed.  is origination. The firm's teams execute: structuring, governance, documentation, banking coordination, investor access. Of the firm's eighteen mandate types, this seat draws most on Family Office Setup, Principal Advisory, Succession, Redomicile, and Co\-Investment.

 Senior private bankers, family office executives, and wealth advisors with 12 to 20 or more years serving UHNW principals in the Gulf or internationally. * A personal network of principals, families, and senior referral professionals in the region
* Direct experience advising on structures, transactions, or capital at the most senior level
* Discretion as a working habit, not a policy
* Comfort with a performance\-based arrangement



  





**Compensation** 




 Senior and performance\-based: direct participation in the advisory fees on engagements you originate and lead. Terms are discussed in detail with qualified candidates.
 



  





**Discretion** 




 All enquiries are treated in strict confidence.

**Job Overview:**
 The PMO Lead directly leads the Project Manager team within the Business Solutions Department and is accountable for portfolio governance, delivery compliance, and PMO framework maturity across all concurrent projects. The PMO Lead sets the delivery standard, coaches the PM team to that standard, and governs how every project is initiated, run, escalated, and closed. As the line manager for the PM team, this role combines people leadership with structural PMO ownership, building the Center of Excellence, driving standardised controls, and producing the executive\-ready reporting that gives the Director and CCO full portfolio visibility. A core outcome is ensuring projects consistently meet or outperform pre\-estimated budgets through baseline discipline, change control enforcement, and early financial intervention.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* PM Team Leadership \& Performance Management
* Directly manage the BSD Project Manager team: set performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, deliver performance reviews, and support professional development
* Assign and balance project workload across the PM team based on complexity, capacity, and growth objectives, ensuring no PM is over\-extended and every project has appropriate coverage
* Coach PMs on methodology, stakeholder management, scope control, and delivery discipline, raising the standard of craft, not just compliance
* Onboard new Project Managers into the BSD delivery model: governance expectations, tooling, reporting cadence, and stakeholder engagement standards
* Act as the first escalation point for PM\-level issues: unblock delivery problems, mediate stakeholder conflicts, and provide senior judgment on complex scope or schedule decisions
* PMO Governance \& Delivery Assurance
* Own and enforce the end\-to\-end PMO governance model: stage gates (G0\-G5\), minimum project artifacts, Director approval workflows, and escalation paths
* Run delivery assurance reviews (health checks, compliance audits, and quality checkpoints) and drive corrective actions where projects deviate from standards
* Ensure consistent application of governance across all project archetypes (white\-label, grey\-label, integration, hybrid) while keeping controls pragmatic and execution\-friendly
* Chair the Change Control Board: intake, impact assessment, approval or rejection, re\-baselining, and communication to all affected stakeholders
* PMO Framework Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
* Maintain and continuously optimise the BSD PMO framework: project lifecycle, standards, templates, toolkits, and playbooks, serving as the single source of truth for how delivery is run
* Identify and eliminate systemic delivery breakdowns: scope creep patterns, late feasibility discovery, rework loops, and weak sign\-off cultures
* Operate with a Center of Excellence mindset: codify lessons learned and best practices, and continuously raise PM methodology maturity across the team
* Maintain PM onboarding documentation and standards, reducing time\-to\-productivity for new Project Managers and eliminating methodology drift
* Portfolio Reporting \& Executive Visibility
* Own the portfolio reporting cadence and outputs: weekly portfolio health review, monthly performance packs, and steering committee materials for the Director and CCO
* Provide data\-backed insights: schedule variance, budget variance, scope volatility, RAID trends, and cross\-project dependency visibility
* Establish and protect a "single source of truth" for portfolio status, with strong data quality and governance traceability across Smartsheet and reporting outputs
* Design and maintain the portfolio dashboard: real\-time RAG status, milestone tracking, resource utilisation, and financial performance across all concurrent projects
* Budget Performance, Baselines \& Financial Controls
* Ensure every project has an approved, documented baseline covering scope, schedule, and budget before execution begins. No project starts without a signed baseline
* Monitor cost performance and forecast\-to\-complete across the portfolio; initiate recovery actions and escalate to the Director when variances exceed defined thresholds
* Enforce change control discipline so that every scope change is formally assessed for time and cost impact, and approved before implementation begins
* Improve estimation hygiene and governance controls to enable projects to consistently meet or outperform pre\-estimated budgets through reduced rework, tighter CR governance, and better resource utilisation
* Partner with the Projects Financial Controller (when in post) on invoicing trigger governance, per\-project P\&L tracking, and commercial change order processes
* RAID, Dependencies \& Cross\-Project Risk
* Standardise RAID governance across the portfolio: every risk, assumption, issue, and dependency has an owner, a mitigation action, and a measurable closure criterion
* Surface and manage cross\-project dependencies proactively, driving early escalation and resolution before they become delivery blockers
* Maintain the portfolio\-level risk register and escalate strategic risks to the Director before they become crises
* Run the post\-implementation review (PIR) process on every project closeout, and embed lessons learned back into the methodology and template library


**Requirements**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent (required)
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or MoP certification, one or more strongly preferred
* Agile certifications such as CSM, PSM, or SAFe are an advantage in hybrid delivery contexts


**Experience Requirements**
* 7\+ years in PMO leadership, portfolio governance, delivery assurance, or project controls, with a minimum of 3 years in a role with direct line management of Project Managers or delivery professionals
* Proven track record building or significantly improving a PMO framework from near\-scratch, with the ability to articulate what changed, why it changed, and what the measurable outcome was
* Demonstrated experience governing a portfolio of 8 or more concurrent complex implementations in technology, B2B, or professional services environments
* Strong background in portfolio analytics and performance reporting, including KPIs, health frameworks, trend analysis, schedule and budget variance, and RAID analytics
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders including Product, Engineering, and commercial teams within a RACI\-governed delivery model
* Preferred: prior experience in a Centre of Excellence, PMO transformation, methodology office, or operational excellence function

**Who We Are** 




 At BKN301, we build fintech solutions that enable banks, fintechs, and merchants to grow and innovate across emerging markets.
