data.jd_text:
**About Invygo**
 Invygo is MENA's leading car subscription and "Subscribe to Own" platform, enabling customers to get a car through an app — with no banks, no down payments, and total flexibility.
   

  

 As we scale across the region, operational excellence is the engine behind the customer promise: the right car, ready on time, maintained well, and paid for reliably. This role owns that engine across our two largest markets.
   

  

****The Role****
 The Head of Operations will own the end\-to\-end operational performance of Invygo across KSA and UAE — from getting cars live on the platform, to fast booking acceptance, to on\-time handover, to fleet maintenance and collections.
   

  

 Based in Riyadh and leading distributed teams across both markets, this role is accountable for the core operational KPIs that determine speed, reliability, and cash health: OTIF handover, acceptance rate and duration, SMA scheduling and quality, fleet upload, and collections (including force collection).
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator and builder — someone who thrives on dashboards and SLAs, can drive a team to consistent execution, and turns operational data into measurable improvements across cost, speed, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Handover \& Fulfilment (OTIF)**
* Own OTIF (On\-Time, In\-Full handover) — ensure cars are delivered to customers on the committed date and time, fully prepared and ready to drive
* Drive acceptance rate up and acceptance duration down — ensure eligible bookings are accepted quickly and reliably across both markets
* Own car upload and live\-inventory readiness — maximise the volume and speed of vehicles made live and bookable on the platform
* Eliminate handover delays through clear SLAs, root\-cause analysis, and tight coordination between supply, logistics, and field teams


**Fleet Service \& Maintenance (SMA)**
* Own SMA scheduling — ensure Scheduled Maintenance Appointments are planned with full coverage, high adherence, and minimal vehicle downtime
* Drive SMA rating and service quality — protect the customer experience through every maintenance and service touchpoint
* Manage vehicle readiness, turnaround time, claims, and the redeployment of returned cars back into live inventory


**Collections \& Recovery**
* Own collection performance — ensure subscription dues are collected on time across the active fleet in both markets
* Lead force collection and recovery — manage enforced collection and overdue\-account recovery while protecting the customer relationship and brand
* Reduce overdue and aging balances through clear processes, escalation paths, and cross\-functional alignment with Finance and CX


**Operational Excellence \& Reporting**
* Own daily operational dashboards and the full KPI set (OTIF, acceptance, upload, SMA, collections) with clear targets per market
* Standardise processes and SLAs across KSA and UAE while respecting local market differences
* Identify bottlenecks and lead continuous\-improvement initiatives that reduce cost and cycle time


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Supply \& Partnerships to align on committed cars, upload pipelines, and supplier performance
* Work with Finance on collections, recovery, forecasting, and operational cost control per market
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data to automate manual workflows and improve operational visibility
* Align closely with CX to ensure handover, maintenance, and collections protect NPS and retention


**People \& Leadership**
* Build, lead, and mentor high\-performing operations teams across KSA and UAE with strong ownership and accountability
* Set clear targets, run performance management, and develop bench strength and succession within the function
* Foster a data\-driven, execution\-focused, and customer\-obsessed operating culture


**Requirements**
**What You Bring**
* 8\+ years in operations, fleet, logistics, last\-mile, mobility, or marketplace operations, with at


 least 4 years in a leadership role.
   

  

* Proven track record owning hard operational KPIs (on\-time delivery/handover, SLA


 adherence, utilisation, collections) at scale.
   

  

* Experience leading distributed or multi\-market teams; managing operations across KSA and


 UAE is a strong advantage.
   

  

* Strong analytical and dashboard\-driven mindset — comfortable with operational data, SQL/BI


 tools, and metric reconciliation.
   

  

* Experience in car rental, leasing, mobility, fintech collections, or fast\-scaling startups is highly


 preferred.
   

  

* Excellent stakeholder management across Supply, Finance, Product, and CX
* Fluent English and Arabic. Based in or willing to relocate to Riyadh


**Benefits**
**Why You'll Love Working with Us**
 At Invygo, the Head of Operations role goes beyond managing day\-to\-day execution—it's about building scalable, efficient systems that enable the business to grow with consistency and speed. You'll have the freedom to optimize processes, drive innovation, and turn ideas into measurable operational impact.
   

  

 Here's what we offer:
   

  

 🚙 Competitive Salary
   

  

 🚙 Employee Stock Options (because we want you to share in our success)
   

  

 🚙 Flexibility: Work from home or abroad
   

  

 🚙 Discounts on invygo's car subscription (yes, your rides just got cooler)
   

  

 🚙 Team Engagement Days filled with collaboration and fun
   

  

**🚗 Ready to Drive Change?**
 If you're someone who thrives on challenges, enjoys working in a dynamic environment, and wants to make an impact, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 👉 Apply now and let's build the smartest way to move—together

* Develop and maintain key project documentation, Project Charters, delivery plans, RAID logs, and progress reports, structured to drive alignment, not just record\-keeping.

****Role Requirements:****

**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description:**
 Aviagen is establishing a new world\-class operation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), comprising farms, a hatchery, a feed mill, a laboratory, and a decontamination facility across multiple locations.
   

  

 To support the successful delivery of this ambitious project, Aviagen has partnered with GPP, a specialist consulting firm with extensive expertise in the design, management, and supervision of poultry industry construction projects.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to join the project team and work closely with both GPP and Aviagen stakeholders throughout the construction phase.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Reporting to the Project Director, the Project Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and control of construction projects, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in accordance with the required quality and safety standards.
   

  

 Acting as the Owner's Representative, the Project Manager will safeguard Aviagen's interests throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that business objectives, contractual commitments, and strategic priorities are achieved.
   

  

 The role serves as the primary coordination point between the Project Director, site supervisors, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders, providing leadership throughout construction, commissioning, and final handover.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of projects, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
* Report regularly to the Project Director and Senior Project Management Team on project performance, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate and manage relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Act as the key interface between engineering disciplines and site teams, ensuring the accurate implementation of designs and technical specifications.
* Provide direction and oversight to site supervisors and ensure consistency in decision\-making and project execution.
* Monitor project progress against established schedules and proactively implement corrective actions where required.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, change orders, and cost control measures.
* Review and approve progress certificates, contractor claims, variation orders, and payment applications.
* Lead, coordinate, and support the site supervision team across multiple project locations.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, project specifications, quality standards, HSE requirements, and local regulatory requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while effectively managing project changes.
* Chair project meetings and ensure timely follow\-up and closure of action items.
* Prepare and deliver regular project status reports, highlighting progress, key achievements, risks, and critical decisions.


**Required**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, construction management, or major capital projects.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale industrial, agricultural, infrastructure, or manufacturing construction projects.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, contract administration, project controls, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management.
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and consultants.
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing project costs and contractual matters.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, scheduling tools, and reporting systems.
* Fluent in English.


**Preferred**
* Experience within poultry, agribusiness, food production, or industrial facility construction projects.
* Previous experience working in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region.
* Familiarity with KSA construction regulations, permitting processes, and local business practices.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar project management tools.
* English is a must \& Arabic language skills would be an advantage.


 What We Offer
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to play a leading role in one of Aviagen's most significant strategic investments in the region. The successful candidate will work alongside international experts and contribute to the successful delivery of a world\-class poultry production operation in Saudi Arabia.

**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management
* Ensure regional capacity is managed in line with global and functional targets, escalating deviations and translating business demand into resourcing inputs for the IT organisation
* Build cost\-to\-serve visibility at office level to support data\-led conversations with both local leadership and global IT
* Challenge and reduce local service deviations where demand doesn’t justify them
* Drive the shift from human\-touch support to automation and self\-service. This is a direction of travel, not a one\-off project
* Automation \& AI\-Enabled Support
* Set and own targets for no\-contact and low\-contact resolution rates across the region
* Build out self\-service capabilities for high\-frequency, routine requests: if a human is handling it repeatedly, it should be automated
* Embed AI\-assisted triage and resolution tooling into local support workflows
* Maintain a live automation backlog and convert repeat demand into scalable workflows systematically
* Improve ticket and knowledge quality to cut engineering escalations and break the cycle of recurring incidents
* Security, Compliance \& Resilience
* Ensure secure fulfilment patterns are embedded in all service workflows, not treated as a separate workstream
* Enforce compliance with device management, access control, and privileged support standards
* Minimise operational risk through disciplined change management and resilience practices
* Partner closely with ISRM: regional security posture is a shared responsibility and I expect you to own your side of i


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT Service Management, Digital Workplace, or End\-User Computing leadership
* Proven experience running multi\-site or regional service delivery across geographically dispersed teams
* Background in service transformation or operating model redesign : you have changed how a function works, not just run it
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-enabled / automated support tooling and modern ESM platforms
* Strong grounding in financial management, capacity planning, and cost\-to\-serve modelling

data.jd_text:
**نبذة عن الدور (Role Overview)** 
 سيتولى رئيس إدارة الاستثمارات قيادة وظيفة الاستثمار وإدارة الأصول بشكل متكامل داخل الشركة، مع الإشراف على محفظة عقارية متنوعة تشمل مخزونًا كبيرًا من الأراضي وأصولًا مدرّة للدخل.
   

 يهدف هذا الدور إلى تعظيم قيمة المحفظة من خلال تنمية صافي الدخل التشغيلي (NOI)، ورفع نسب الإشغال، وتحسين أداء الأصول، وتنفيذ استراتيجيات استثمارية متوافقة مع رؤية الشركة طويلة المدى. ويتطلب الدور الجمع بين الفهم التجاري العميق والقدرة التنفيذية العملية في مجالات الاستحواذ، ودراسات الجدوى التطويرية، واستراتيجيات التأجير، وإعادة تموضع الأصول.
   

**المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية (Key Responsibilities)** 
**1\. إدارة المحفظة والأصول (Portfolio \& Asset Management)** 
* تحمل المسؤولية الكاملة عن أداء المحفظة العقارية للشركة، بما في ذلك الأصول التشغيلية والتطويرية
* تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات على مستوى المحفظة لتعظيم العوائد وتحسين توزيع الأصول وتعزيز القيمة طويلة الأجل
* تحقيق نمو في صافي الدخل التشغيلي (NOI)، ورفع نسب الإشغال، وتحسين معدلات تجديد العقود، وتحسين مزيج المستأجرين
* قيادة مبادرات إعادة تموضع الأصول، وإعادة تطويرها، وتعزيز قيمتها


**2\. استراتيجية الاستثمار والتنفيذ (Investment Strategy \& Execution)** 
* إعداد وتنفيذ استراتيجية الاستثمار العقاري للشركة بما يتماشى مع الأهداف المؤسسية
* قيادة عمليات تقييم الفرص الاستثمارية، والنماذج المالية، ودراسات الجدوى، وتحليل الحساسية
* تقييم الفرص عبر الاستحواذات، والشراكات، والمشاريع التطويرية، وعمليات التخارج
* إدارة توزيع رأس المال بين تطوير الأراضي والأصول المدرة للدخل


**3\. التأجير والأداء التجاري (Leasing \& Commercial Performance)** 
* الإشراف على استراتيجية التأجير، والتفاوض مع المستأجرين، وأداء فريق التأجير
* ضمان إدارة فعالة لعلاقات المستأجرين ووضع استراتيجيات للاحتفاظ بهم
* متابعة اتجاهات السوق لضمان الحفاظ على القدرة التنافسية وتحقيق نمو في الإيجارات


**4\. الأداء المالي والتقارير (Financial Performance \& Reporting)** 
* إعداد وتقديم تقارير دورية على مستوى مجلس الإدارة حول أداء الأصول والمحفظة
* متابعة المؤشرات الرئيسية للأداء مثل IRR، والتدفقات النقدية، وNOI، والعائد، ونسب الإشغال، وROI
* قيادة إعداد الميزانية السنوية والتوقعات وتحليل الانحرافات
* ضمان تطبيق حوكمة مالية قوية والانضباط الاستثماري


**5\. تحسين استغلال مخزون الأراضي والتكامل مع التطوير (Landbank Optimization \& Development Interface)** 
* تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات تسويق واستغلال مخزون الأراضي الواسع للشركة
* التعاون مع فرق التطوير والتخطيط والتنفيذ لتحسين الجدوى والعوائد للمشاريع
* التوصية باستراتيجيات التنفيذ المرحلي، وأفضل استخدام للأراضي، وآليات تحقيق الدخل منها


**6\. إدارة أصحاب المصلحة (Stakeholder Management)** 
* العمل كنقطة الاتصال الرئيسية مع أصحاب المصلحة الداخليين، والإدارة العليا، وأعضاء مجلس الإدارة
* بناء علاقات مع المستثمرين والشركاء والوسطاء والمؤسسات المالية
* إدارة المستشارين الخارجيين بما في ذلك المقيمين العقاريين والاستشاريين ووكلاء التأجير


**7\. قيادة الفريق (Team Leadership)** 
* بناء وقيادة وتطوير فريق عالي الأداء في مجال الاستثمارات وإدارة الأصول
* وضع أفضل الممارسات والأنظمة والعمليات لقرارات الاستثمار وإدارة الأصول
* تعزيز ثقافة قائمة على الأداء والتحليل داخل الإدارة


**ملف المرشح (Candidate Profile)** 
**الخبرة والمهارات (Experience \& Skills)** 
* خبرة لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في الاستثمارات العقارية أو إدارة الأصول أو إدارة المحافظ
* سجل حافل في إدارة محافظ عقارية كبيرة ومخزون أراضي واسع
* خبرة قوية في النمذجة المالية والتقييم والتحليل الاستثماري
* سجل مثبت في تحسين أداء الأصول وتنفيذ الاستراتيجيات الاستثمارية
* يفضل وجود خبرة في السوق العقاري في المملكة العربية السعودية أو دول الخليج


**المهارات الفنية (Technical Competencies)** 
* مهارات متقدمة في النمذجة المالية واستخدام برنامج Excel
* فهم عميق لأساليب تقييم العقارات
* معرفة بهياكل التأجير واقتصاديات التطوير والأسواق المالية
* إلمام بالأنظمة والتشريعات العقارية في المملكة العربية السعودية


**القدرات القيادية (Leadership Competencies)** 
* تفكير استراتيجي مع فهم تجاري قوي
* قدرة تنفيذية عملية مع التركيز على النتائج
* مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على تقديم العروض أمام مجلس الإدارة
* مهارات قوية في إدارة العلاقات والتفاوض

Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 This is an opportunity to work on one of the largest programmes in Saudi Arabia. This unique project consists of major mixed\-use development including sports facilities, entertainment, and arts along with all associated infrastructure.
   

  

 Mace is one of the delivery partners requiring high\-calibre and experienced professionals to lead integrated teams throughout each phase of the project.
   

  

 The construction director shall act as a senior site\-based construction and delivery lead within the client project management team to support the recovery and successful delivery of the project.
   

  

 The role is focused on monitoring, assessing, coordinating, and supporting the Contractor’s construction activities, subcontractor coordination, sequencing, productivity, and site execution to assist in maintaining the approved recovery programme and achievement of key project milestones.
   

  

**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Lead, manage and coordinate the senior construction managers assigned across the project.
* Allocate responsibilities across project zones, assets, systems, and work fronts to ensure effective site coverage and monitoring.
* Ensure proactive identification and escalation of critical delivery risks, subcontractor performance issues, and programme concerns across all project areas.
* Lead regular coordination and review meetings with the senior construction managers to ensure alignment of priorities, recovery actions, and project objectives.
* Review progress against the approved programme, recovery plans, and key milestones.
* Support the contractor and project stakeholders in identifying and implementing practical mitigation and recovery measures.
* Undertake regular site walks and field assessments to validate actual progress and site conditions.
* Identify underperforming subcontractors, trade clashes, and interface issues impacting programme delivery.
* Facilitate collaborative resolution of coordination and execution issues between the contractor, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and stakeholders.
* Support the recovery director in monitoring implementation of the approved recovery strategy and mitigation plans.
* Review look\-ahead programmes, recovery schedules, and critical path activities.
* Provide regular factual reporting and recommendations to the client project management team and recovery director.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Minimum 15\+ years’ experience in large\-scale construction and site delivery.
* Degree qualified in engineering, construction management, or related discipline.
* Proven experience on complex or distressed projects requiring recovery and mitigation initiatives.
* Strong experience managing multidisciplinary construction teams and subcontractor coordination across large\-scale projects.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and have relevant work experience working on high valued projects/programmes for a project management consultancy business, which are required for immigration and client approval.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** 
 We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.
   

  

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with\-in the role

 Delivery:

 Quality:

 alfanar derives its success from its commitment to providing the highest quality standards to its customers, and the continuous development of its human capital, who alfanar considers its most valuable asset. As a General Manager, you are responsible for bringing Earth Riyadh to life.

You will oversee every aspect of the pre\-opening journey, including recruitment, culture building, operational readiness, commercial performance, guest experience, and brand delivery.
   

  

 Earth Riyadh is more than a hotel. It is a social destination built around design, food, wellness, creativity, and human connection. The General Manager will be the on\-property custodian of this vision, ensuring every touchpoint reflects the Earth Hotels philosophy of creating joyful places that inspire people to wake up every day. This role requires a highly visible, hands\-on leader who thrives in lifestyle hospitality environments and enjoys building something from the ground up.
   

  

**What on Earth Will You Do?**
* Lead the complete pre\-opening process from project handover through launch and stabilization.
* Work closely with Development, Design, Technical Services, Brand, Finance, and Citizen \& Culture teams to ensure all critical milestones are achieved.
* Build and execute the opening critical path, ensuring operational readiness across every department.

* Oversee procurement, OS\&E installation, testing, commissioning, and departmental readiness.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop the opening leadership team and wider citizen community.

* Create a guest\-first environment where every Earthling feels welcomed, inspired, and connected.
* Maintain exceptional standards across service, cleanliness, presentation, and safety.
* Monitor guest feedback and continuously evolve the experience through innovation and creativity.
* Remain highly visible throughout the property, engaging with guests and citizens daily.
* Position Earth Riyadh as one of the city's most exciting lifestyle destinations.
* Champion activations across F\&B, wellness, retail, music, art, and community events.
* Build relationships with local creators, artists, wellness practitioners, brands, and entrepreneurs.
* Drive a culture where the hotel feels alive every day through thoughtful programming and collaborations.
* Ensure the property remains authentic to the Earth Hotels identity of creativity, inclusivity, and connection.
* Deliver annual revenue, GOP, and EBITDA targets.
* Manage budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and asset protection.
* Work closely with Revenue, Sales, and Marketing teams to optimize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and total hotel revenue.
* Drive strong performance across accommodation, destination dining, wellness, memberships, events, and retail experiences.
* Identify new partnerships and commercial opportunities that strengthen the Earth brand and improve profitability.
* Ensure the hotel's restaurants, cafés, retail spaces, and wellness facilities become destination venues in their own right.
* Work closely with the F\&B and Wellness leaders to curate experiences that drive both guest satisfaction and local engagement.
* Maintain high standards across product quality, programming, atmosphere, and service delivery.
* Champion innovation while ensuring commercial viability.
* Recruit, inspire, coach, and develop a high\-performing leadership team.
* Build a culture that is collaborative, inclusive, entrepreneurial, and accountable.
* Ensure strong succession planning and talent development throughout the property.
* Foster an environment where citizens feel empowered to contribute ideas and shape the guest experience.
* Partner closely with Citizen \& Culture to maintain high engagement and retention.
* Act as the ultimate guardian of the Earth Hotels brand on property.
* Ensure the hotel's design, service style, energy, and experiences consistently reflect the Earth philosophy.
* Challenge traditional hospitality thinking and encourage continuous improvement.
* Drive innovation across operations, guest engagement, technology, and sustainability.
* Build meaningful relationships with local partners, suppliers, government stakeholders, and the wider community.
* Champion sustainable operating practices throughout the hotel.
* Support initiatives that create positive environmental and social impact.
* Position the hotel as a responsible and engaged member of the local community.
* Ensure full compliance with all Saudi regulations, licensing requirements, health and safety legislation, and Earth Hotels policies.
* Maintain operational readiness for audits and inspections.
* Oversee emergency procedures, security protocols, and crisis management planning.
* Provide regular operational and commercial updates to ownership and corporate leadership.
* Monitor and report on all key financial, operational, guest satisfaction, and people metrics.
* Represent Earth Hotels professionally within the market and the broader hospitality industry.
* Lead by example and embody the values and culture of the brand.
* Ensure all health, safety, hygiene, and service standards are consistently maintained.
* Promote a safe, welcoming, and positive environment for Earthlings and citizens alike.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Objective / Purpose**
 The Director \- Modern Methods of Construction will lead Qiddiya's strategy for the implementation of Modern Methods of Construction (MMC), including Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFMA) and modular construction across large\-scale, complex projects. This role ensures that Qiddiya remains at the forefront of construction innovation, establishing robust methodologies, fostering strong supply chain partnerships, and embedding DFMA best practices across the Development and Delivery functions.
   

  

**Technical Responsibilities**
* Define, implement, and oversee Qiddiya's DFMA and modular construction strategy in alignment with the organization's delivery objectives
* Lead research and development (R\&D) initiatives to evaluate emerging MMC technologies and recommend adoption pathways tailored to Qiddiya's portfolio
* Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise to business units and delivery partners on the integration of DFMA principles in project planning, design, and execution
* Establish and manage a framework for evaluating suppliers, manufacturers, and technology providers within the DFMA/MMC ecosystem
* Collaborate with design, engineering, and construction teams to embed DFMA principles from concept through delivery, ensuring measurable efficiencies in time, cost, and quality
* Develop policies, procedures, and technical guidelines for modular and prefabricated construction within Qiddiya's delivery governance system
* Coordinate knowledge\-sharing sessions and training initiatives across internal teams and delivery partners to build organizational DFMA capability
* Monitor international MMC/DFMA trends, benchmarking against global best practices, and apply insights to Qiddiya's development program
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with modular and prefabricated construction methodologies
* Act as the primary liaison with specialized consultants, industry experts, and academic partners in advancing DFMA and MMC innovation
* Support the Strategic Delivery Unit \- Delivery Partnerships Lead in strategic planning, ensuring modular/R\&D initiatives are integrated into the broader Delivery Partnerships roadmap
* Oversee pilot projects showcasing MMC/DFMA innovation, capturing lessons learned for replication across the portfolio


**Requirements**
* Degree: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field
* Experience: Minimum 15\-20 years in large\-scale project delivery with at least 7\-10 years in DFMA, MMC, or modular construction leadership roles
* Licenses / Certifications:
+ Chartered Engineer (CEng), PMP, or equivalent professional certification preferred
+ Specialized training in modular construction, prefabrication, or DFMA methodologies desirable

* Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and change management capabilities; proven track record in innovation adoption and cross\-functional delivery


**Application closes on 28 May 2026**

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Resource Manager – Project Development (Geology) is responsible for leading and managing all geology\-related activities across project development stages, including Scoping Studies, Pre Feasibility Studies (PFS), and Feasibility Studies (FS).
   

  

 The role ensures the availability, accuracy, and integrity of geological data, resource models, and mineral resource estimates to support project evaluation and decision\-making. It drives value optimization of mineral resources, ensures alignment with international standards (e.g., JORC), and provides integrated geological inputs into mine planning, economic evaluation, and project advancement.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Geological Leadership in Studies
* Lead all geological workstreams across Scoping, PFS, and FS studies
* Define geological scope, deliverables, and timelines for each study phase
* Ensure timely and high\-quality geological inputs into study reports
* Resource Estimation \& Modelling
* Oversee development and validation of geological models and mineral resource estimates
* Ensure compliance with international reporting standards (e.g., JORC)
* Review and approve resource classification and estimation methodologies
* Data Management \& Quality Assurance
* Ensure integrity, completeness, and proper management of geological databases
* Implement and monitor QA/QC protocols across all geological activities
* Validate that all data used in studies meets required technical and audit standards
* Integration with Project Development
* Provide geological inputs for mine planning, scheduling, and economic evaluation
* Support pit optimization and mine design through accurate geological interpretation
* Collaborate with mining, geotechnical, hydrogeology, and processing teams

SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.

SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 We are seeking a highly experienced Project Director / Technical Director to lead the study and design delivery of major metro projects. The ideal candidate will bring at least 20 years of professional experience in rail and metro infrastructure, with strong expertise across the full project development cycle, including feasibility studies, concept design, preliminary design, and tender documentation phases. Experience in multidisciplinary design management, including coordination of out\-of\-country design
   

  

 centres and subconsultants, is essential. Experience in the Middle East will be considered a strong advantage.
   

  

 This role requires both strategic leadership and deep technical oversight, ensuring high\-quality multidisciplinary design delivery, effective client engagement, commercial performance, and successful coordination across internal teams, international design offices, and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

 The Project Director / Technical Director will provide overall leadership for metro study and design assignments, ensuring that technical, commercial, and program objectives are achieved. The successful candidate will direct multidisciplinary teams involved in rail planning, civil, structural, geotechnical, systems, stations, depots, track, MEP, architecture, and interface management.
   

  

 The role includes leading and reviewing project development activities from early\-stage feasibility and concept studies through preliminary design and tender package preparation. The candidate will oversee technical quality, design integration, risk management, client communication, stakeholder coordination, and management of distributed design delivery models involving international design centres and specialist subconsultants.
   

  

 The individual will also act as the senior point of contact for clients, authorities, partners, and key project stakeholders, supporting business development activities where required and contributing to bid preparation, methodology definition, resource planning, and project strategy.
   

  

* Lead the delivery of metro and urban rail study/design projects from feasibility stage through tender stage.
* Provide technical direction and strategic oversight across multidisciplinary design teams.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and overall performance.
* Lead multidisciplinary design management across internal teams, out\-of\-country design centres, and subconsultants.
* Ensure effective coordination, interface management, and quality control across geographically distributed design teams.
* Oversee the preparation and review of feasibility studies, concept designs, preliminary designs, and tender documents.

* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, international standards, and project governance procedures.
* Manage interfaces with clients, authorities, operators, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Identify project risks and opportunities and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support value engineering, constructability reviews, and design optimization.
* Provide leadership in quality assurance and technical review processes.
* Review and manage the outputs of partner organizations and specialist subconsultants to ensure alignment with project requirements.
* Mentor senior engineers and discipline leads and foster a high\-performance project environment.
* Support proposals, bids, and business development initiatives related to metro and rail opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in metro, rail, or major urban transit infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience in metro projects is essential.
* Proven experience in the following project phases is mandatory:
+ Feasibility studies
+ Concept design
+ Preliminary design
+ Tender stage / tender documentation

* Strong experience in multidisciplinary design management.
* Proven experience managing design delivery involving out\-of\-country design centres and subconsultants.
* Strong experience in the management and coordination of multidisciplinary design teams.
* Proven ability to lead large and complex transportation infrastructure projects.
* Experience dealing directly with clients, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Middle East project experience is a strong advantage.
* Professional registration or chartership is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of metro and urban rail project development.
* Understanding of alignment design, station planning, depot concepts, interfaces, and systems integration.
* Familiarity with international design codes, rail/metro standards, and project delivery best practices.
* Strong understanding of tender documentation, technical specifications, design reports, and scope definition.
* Ability to review and challenge technical solutions to ensure safety, efficiency, and value.

 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 Reporting to the Project Director, the Technical Manager shall lead and manage all technical and engineering oversight functions on behalf of the Project Management Consultant (PMC) for a major road/highway construction project. The role is responsible for ensuring that the Contractor's designs, construction methods, materials, and execution comply with contract requirements, applicable standards, approvals, and best engineering practices, while supporting successful delivery in terms of quality, safety, cost, and schedule.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Technical Leadership \& Oversight**
* Act as the overall technical authority within the PMC team for highway, interchange, and bridge works, including earthworks, pavements, drainage, structures, and associated utilities.
* Review, assess, and provide recommendations on the Contractor's technical submissions, including:
+ Design deliverables (where applicable).
+ Construction methodologies and temporary works.
+ Sequence of works and traffic management schemes.

* Ensure compliance with contract requirements, specifications, approved drawings, and relevant international and local standards (e.g. AASHTO, Eurocodes, Saudi Arabian local road authority standards).


**Contractor Supervision \& Interface**
* Provide technical direction and clarification to the Construction Supervision Team and interface closely with discipline leads (roads, structures, utilities, geotechnical, QA/QC).
* Lead technical coordination with the Construction Contractor, method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, and design changes.
* Participate in technical meetings, design reviews, and resolution of interface issues between different work packages and stakeholders.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Oversee the implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems on site, ensuring construction activities meet the specified technical and performance criteria.
* Review non‑conformance reports (NCRs), corrective actions, and technical concessions raised by the Contractor.
* Support audits and inspections related to materials, workmanship, and construction processes, particularly for critical elements such as bridges and structures.


**Design \& Constructability Review (where applicable)**
* Review Contractor‑proposed designs or design changes to ensure:
+ Constructability and compliance with scope.
+ Safety during construction and operation.
+ Whole‑life performance and durability.

* Participate in value engineering and technical optimization exercises without compromising safety, quality, or contractual obligations.


**Risk, Safety \& Technical Assurance**
* Support identification and mitigation of technical risks, constructability risks, and interface risks associated with road and bridge works.
* Ensure technical aspects of construction methods comply with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements, including temporary works and traffic management.
* Contribute to risk assessments, method reviews, and safety\-in\-design considerations.


**Progress Monitoring \& Reporting**
* Monitor technical progress against approved baselines and contribute to monthly progress reports from a technical perspective.
* Identify potential technical issues that may impact schedule, cost, or performance, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support the Project Manager in evaluating technical implications of variations, claims, and change orders.


**Team Management \& Knowledge Sharing**
* Provide leadership, guidance, and mentoring to PMC discipline engineers and inspectors.
* Ensure consistent application of technical standards and PMC procedures across all site teams.
* Promote effective communication and coordination within the PMC and with external stakeholders.


**About You**
* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (Master's degree or above preferred).
* Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional registration preferred.
* Minimum 20\-25 years of experience in road, highway, and bridge projects, with significant exposure to construction supervision and/or PMC roles.
* Proven experience managing or overseeing large D\&B contractors on major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong background in bridges, interchanges, pavement systems, and earthworks.
* In‑depth knowledge of highway and bridge construction practices.
* Ability to manage multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with international standards and Saudi Arabia/GCC technical standards.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Tax\-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation \& housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Purpose
 
 Execute the main procurement activities including Sourcing, contracting and supplier developments in addition to Purchasing requested materials, Services, Assets, MRO and General Purchasing with right specifications, price, quality, and delivery time / right location from right source
 


 Key Accountability Areas
 
  Supplier Development and Evaluation:
 


* Develop suppliers to meet objectives related to cost savings, delivery performance, and materials quality.
* Perform regular supplier performance evaluations to establish supplier development plans, including development and sourcing\-related activities.
* Visit suppliers for required prequalification, evaluate, develop suppliers, and strengthen business partnerships in coordination with the commodity head and business unit (BU) quality teams.



 Sourcing and Contracting:
 


* Execute sourcing and contracting plans based on the AED sourcing strategy.
* Maximize the number of contracted items within the scope of work with approved suppliers to secure prices, delivery, payment terms, and quality while saving purchasing cycle time.
* Ensure commercial, legal, and contractual compliance in all procurement transactions.



 Procurement Execution:
 


* Understand detailed requirements for each purchase request, including description, specifications, quantity, UOM, and delivery date, with alignment and coordination with requesters or related BU technical teams.
* Manage the execution of purchase requests through processing RFx (RFQ, RFI, etc.) from the identified source list (Approved/Qualified suppliers).
* Negotiate for the best purchase conditions, considering required specifications, delivery time, and cost elements (lower price, best delivery date, best Incoterm/payment term).



 Materials and Specifications Management:
 


* Initiate alternative material specifications according to market availability with the involvement of related BU technical teams.
* Compare quotations based on the approved comparison form, considering the best commercial (landed cost) and delivery terms.
* Identify selected suppliers with the involvement of BU\-related technical teams/requesters (if required) and issue Purchase Orders (POs) on the system to the winning supplier based on winner criteria.



 Purchase Order Management:
 


* Ensure the PO has all required attached documents (Quotations, communications, etc.).
* Follow the Alfanar PO approval matrix to obtain the final approved order.
* Send approved purchase orders to suppliers and follow up to receive order acknowledgment.
* Follow the PO delivery schedule with suppliers and related departments (Inbound Logistics) until materials arrive and the order is closed by paying the supplier.



 Procurement Coordination and Vendor Management:
 


* Effectively contribute to procurement activities (Sourcing, Development, Evaluation, Contracting) with required coordination with related commodity heads.
* Maintain vendor master information and ensure it is up to date.
* Manage non\-conformity processes for rejected supplied materials, and lead corrective/preventive actions with the involvement of other related departments (Quality, Store, Finance, etc.).


 Role Accountability
 
 HR Proficiency:
 


* Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job
* To have a vision and a plan for the career path and how to achieve it.



 Delivery:
 


* Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
* Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
* Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.



 Problem\-Solving:
 


* Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.



 Quality:
 


* Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.



 Business Process Improvements:
 


* Coordinate well\-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.



 Compliance:
 


* Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions.



 Health, Safety, and Environment:
 


* Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high\-quality products/services.

 Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a wide variety of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products, in addition to its portfolio of conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions.
 



  
 



 The hub of alfanar’s manufacturing operations is Medinet alfanar Alsinaiya, a 700,000 square\-meter complex located in Riyadh. **Position Summary**
**What We Need**
 We are looking for a reliable, proactive, and organized
 **Account Delivery Operations Specialist** 
 to support the daily operations of a large strategic account. This role will support account operations, delivery follow\-up, customer\-related topics, reporting, presentations, meeting coordination, documentation, finance follow\-up, and routine operational activities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to take ownership of assigned tasks, follow up independently, and help close operational and administrative gaps without requiring continuous reminders. This role requires strong coordination skills, good communication in Arabic and English, and a basic understanding of software delivery and technical project environments.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the Account Manager, project teams, delivery managers, technical teams, finance teams, vendors, and client stakeholders to ensure that actions, reports, documents, meetings, and follow\-ups are completed accurately and on time.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Support day\-to\-day account operations and delivery coordination activities across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Follow up on project actions, blockers, deadlines, approvals, submissions, and pending items.
* Coordinate with delivery teams, project managers, technical teams, finance teams, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Prepare regular status reports, trackers, dashboards, progress updates, and account\-level summaries.
* Support the preparation of presentations for internal meetings, client meetings, executive reviews, and governance sessions.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes of meetings, action logs, decision logs, and follow\-up trackers.
* Track delivery progress, team updates, risks, issues, dependencies, and open actions.
* Support customer\-related follow\-ups and help ensure client requests are tracked and addressed.
* Maintain organized records, files, reports, trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate and follow up on invoices, purchase orders, approvals, and finance\-related documents.
* Ensure finance and administrative documents are completed, submitted, and followed up properly.
* Support the team in identifying, fixing, and closing administrative and operational gaps.
* Maintain clear visibility on daily priorities, pending items, and required actions.
* Support basic delivery governance activities, including weekly status updates and action tracking.
* Work full\-time onsite at the client office in Riyadh.


**What You Have**
**Required Skills and Competencies**
* Strong follow\-up, coordination, and ownership skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills in Arabic and English.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, clients, vendors, and finance stakeholders.
* Good understanding of project\-based delivery environments.
* Basic understanding of software development, technical projects, releases, incidents, change requests, and delivery lifecycle.
* Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Ability to prepare clear reports, trackers, calculations, documentation, and presentations.
* Ability to summarize information clearly for management and customer meetings.
* Basic to good knowledge of Power BI is preferred.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or similar tools is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under deadlines.
* Positive attitude, responsiveness, and willingness to support the team.
* Proactive approach to closing pending items without waiting for repeated instructions.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Project Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience may be considered in place of a specific educational background.


**Experience**
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, delivery coordination, account coordination, administration, reporting, finance coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working in software delivery, IT services, digital platforms, or project\-based environments is preferred.
* Experience with invoices, project documentation, trackers, reports, presentations, and stakeholder follow\-up is preferred.


 Experience supporting client\-facing teams or large accounts is a strong plus
   

  

**Technical And Tool Skills**
* Microsoft Excel: required.
* Microsoft PowerPoint: required.
* Microsoft Word: required.
* Power BI: preferred.
* Jira or similar project tracking tools: preferred.
* Confluence or SharePoint: preferred.
* Reporting and dashboard preparation: preferred.
* Invoice and document tracking: required.
* Finance and administrative coordination: preferred.


**Work Arrangement**
* Full\-time position.
* Full\-time onsite presence is required at the client office in Riyadh.
* Remote or hybrid work is not applicable.
* The candidate must be comfortable working daily from the customer office.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate is someone who:
   

  

* Takes ownership of tasks and follows up until completion.
* Can work independently with minimal supervision.
* Initiates action when something is pending, blocked, unclear, or delayed.
* Is comfortable working with project teams, account teams, finance teams, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Can prepare clear reports, trackers, meeting notes, and presentations.
* Has enough technical understanding to follow software delivery discussions and summarize updates clearly.
* Is consistent, organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented.
* Is willing to support the team in closing operational and administrative gaps.
* Can handle daily pressure in a large account environment.
* Is comfortable working onsite at the client office every day.


**Reporting To**
 Account Manager / Delivery Manager / Head of Account Delivery Operations
   

  

 Scope.
   

  

 Responsible for supporting account\-level operations, delivery coordination, administrative governance, reporting, documentation, finance follow\-up, meeting coordination, and daily operational follow\-ups across a large strategic client account.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in the region and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA and Amazon, as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi Arabia’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We're seeking an
 **Engineering Manager II** 
 to lead a critical area of our engineering organization. In this role, you will be accountable for the delivery and technical strategy across multiple complex and related domains within our product. You will lead a high\-performing team of 6\-10 senior engineers, potentially structured across two squads, driving the execution of team\-level goals that are directly aligned with broader organizational priorities.
   

  

 Drawing on your deep expertise in software development and proven leadership, you will guide the architectural evolution of your team's systems, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and performant. You will be a key partner to product and business leadership, influencing medium\- and long\-term strategy and ensuring your teams are focused on delivering measurable impact.
   

  

 Your ultimate responsibility is to orchestrate technical excellence, foster the growth of senior engineers and future leaders, manage complex cross\-team dependencies, and transform how millions of users engage in shopping, payment, and banking activities.
   

  

 You are a driven, determined, and curious leader, who knows that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution\-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Strategy: Inspire and guide a group of senior engineers, setting a clear direction that aligns with the company vision. Drive alignment between technology goals and product priorities, advocating for long\-term technical quality alongside short\-term delivery.
* People Leadership \& Development: Develop both direct reports and skip\-levels for future leadership roles. Create growth opportunities for senior engineers, mentor those aspiring to become Engineering Manager I's, and support the success of new managers. Drive team structure decisions, hiring plans, and succession planning while effectively managing performance across all levels.
* Technical Excellence: Lead architectural discussions for your team's systems. Drive continuous improvements to system reliability, performance, and scalability. Monitor technical health and ensure the team maintains a healthy balance between new feature delivery and technical investment.
* Execution \& Delivery: Define and own the delivery plans for initiatives that span multiple teams. Own resource allocation and hiring strategy for your area. Proactively identify and resolve complex cross\-team delivery challenges, making strategic trade\-offs between short\- and long\-term value. Provide clear visibility to leadership on project status, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Product \& Business Partnership: Partner directly with Product and business leadership to influence medium\- and long\-term product strategies. Ensure your teams are focusing on measurable outcomes and ROI, and encourage a culture of thoughtful experimentation aligned with strategic goals.
* Team Health \& Collaboration: Build a healthy, inclusive environment of trust, ownership, and accountability. Foster a strong collaboration and knowledge\-sharing culture. Work closely with peer Engineering Managers and the architecture board to ensure alignment and drive standards across the engineering organization.


**Your Expertise**
* You have at least 4\+ years of experience managing one or more engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing senior individual contributors and leading projects of medium\-to\-high complexity.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery for initiatives spanning multiple teams or complex product domains.
* Strong technical background in modern software development (e.g., Java/Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Messaging Queues, Cloud Services), with experience leading architectural discussions and driving technical strategy.
* Experience partnering with product managers to influence product roadmaps and align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Proven ability to develop engineering talent, including mentoring senior engineers and aspiring managers.
* Expertise in Agile methodologies and experience resolving complex, cross\-team delivery challenges in a fast\-paced environment.
* Fintech or eCommerce experience is a strong plus.

data.jd_text:
At Deewan, www.deewan.sa, we're on a mission to reinvent how businesses connect, collaborate, and communicate. Born in Saudi Arabia and built for the digital age, we fuse breakthrough technology with deep industry expertise to create secure, scalable, and intelligent communication platforms that drive real business results.
   

  

 Our partner network spans the MEA region with international access to messaging hubs worldwide. Our clients include major banks, financial institutions, digital payment providers, OTT applications, government authorities, healthcare, education, and other key industry verticals.
   

  

 If you have a passion for winning and are ready to challenge yourself every day in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment — Deewan is where you belong
   

  

 We are looking for a driven and results\-oriented Sales Executive to join Deewan's growing sales team in Riyadh. This is a pure hunting role, as a single contributer,. Your primary mission is to identify, engage, and close new medium to large customers for Deewan's CPaaS and SaaS communication solutions.
   

  

 You will leverage your existing market knowledge, industry network, and consultative selling skills to open new doors and build a strong pipeline of high\-value opportunities. This is a high\-impact, individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives on the thrill of winning new business.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**New Business Development (Core Focus)**
* Proactively hunt, identify, and acquire new medium to large clients across target sectors (Banking, Fintech, Government, Healthcare, Retail, etc.)
* Build and manage a robust pipeline through cold outreach, networking, referrals, events, and market intelligence
* Conduct discovery meetings and present tailored CPaaS/SaaS solutions that address each prospect's specific communication challenges
* Own the full sales cycle — from first contact through to contract signature


**Sales Targets \& Revenue**
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual new business revenue targets
* Maintain accurate pipeline records and provide regular forecasts using CRM tools
* Report on sales activity, pipeline health, and deal progress to the Head of Sales


**Consultative Selling \& Solution Alignment**
* Develop a deep understanding of Deewan's product portfolio and articulate clear value propositions to C\-level and senior decision\-makers
* Map client business needs to Deewan solutions and collaborate with internal teams (pre\-sales, product, delivery) to craft compelling proposals


**Market Intelligence**
* Stay up to date with trends, competitors, and regulatory developments in the Saudi CPaaS/SaaS landscape
* Share market insights and prospect feedback with leadership to inform product and go\-to\-market strategy


**Contract Negotiation \& Closing**
* Lead commercial negotiations and close agreements on terms that are favorable for both the client and Deewan
* Ensure smooth handover to account management and delivery teams post\-signature


**Requirements**
**Required**
* Minimum 2\-5 years of proven new business (hunter) sales experience in CPaaS, SaaS, Telecommunications, or a closely related technology sector
* Strong, demonstrable track record of selling to medium to large clients in Saudi Arabia
* Deep familiarity with the KSA market: key sectors, buying behaviors, and decision\-making processes
* Existing network of medium to large account contacts in the KSA market is a strong advantage
* Experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles


**Preferred**
* Prior exposure to CPaaS products such as SMS, WhatsApp Business, RCS, OTP, voice, or omnichannel communication platforms
* Arabic \& English language proficiency (spoken and written)
* Experience working with government, banking, fintech, or healthcare sectors in KSA


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Hunter mentality — self\-motivated, tenacious, and hungry to win new business
* Excellent consultative selling and solution\-mapping abilities
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in Arabic and/or English
* Ability to engage and influence at C\-level and senior stakeholder levels
* High commercial acumen and ability to build a business case for clients
* Proficient in CRM software (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite
* Strong organizational skills — ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
* Ethical, professional, and a strong team player


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or a related field
* A relevant professional certification or MBA is a plus, but not mandatory

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Strategic Leadership Overview:
   

  

 Lead WSP’s Middle East Mission Critical Sector as the Senior / Technical Director, with a primary focus on Data Centres while owning the strategy and growth across a broader portfolio of mission\-critical sub\-sectors. In this highly visible leadership role, you will define the regional vision for Mission Critical, shape sub\-sector strategies, and expand WSP’s market presence in the rapidly evolving mission\-critical infrastructure landscape.
   

  

 Your leadership will directly influence growth performance, strengthen strategic client relationships, and elevate WSP’s Mission Critical portfolio — establishing repeatable, high\-performance solutions across data centres and adjacent mission\-critical environments where uptime, resilience, speed\-to\-commissioning, and operational continuity are paramount.
   

  

 You will oversee the delivery of high\-quality consulting services, lead strategic initiatives, ensure exceptional client satisfaction, and achieve key Profit \& Loss (P\&L) performance targets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Vision \& Strategy:
   

  

* Define and execute the regional strategy for mission\-critical data centres, aligning with WSP’s global vision and Middle East priorities.
* Own the Mission Critical sector architecture and sub\-sector strategies (with data centres as the primary focus), including value proposition, priority accounts, partner strategy, capability roadmap, and a repeatable go\-to\-market plan for each sub\-sector. Establish clear scorecards and governance to track pipeline, conversion, margin, delivery performance, and sector maturity.


 Cross\-Business Collaboration:
   

  

* Champion collaboration across Advisory, Engineering, Sustainability, and Digital practices to deliver integrated solutions that maximize value for clients.


 Market Expansion:
   

  

* Position WSP as the partner of choice for hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centre clients, while advancing regional and multi\-sector priorities across the Mission Critical portfolio.


 Client Engagement:
   

  

* Strengthen relationships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring exceptional satisfaction and trust in WSP’s delivery capabilities.


 Operational Excellence:
   

  

* Oversee the delivery of high\-quality consulting and engineering services, ensuring projects meet mission\-critical standards for resilience, efficiency, and sustainability across data centres specifically.


 P\&L Accountability:
   

  

* Drive financial performance by achieving key Profit \& Loss (P\&L) targets, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring sustainable growth.


 Business Development:
   

  

* Lead strategic initiatives to expand WSP’s footprint in the Middle East data centre market, securing new opportunities and partnerships.


 Quality, Safety \& Operations (QSO):
   

  

* Uphold WSP’s commitment to quality, safety, and operational excellence, setting the tone for industry\-leading standards in mission\-critical delivery.


 Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead, inspire, and manage a diverse team of technical and strategic consultants and subject matter experts. Foster a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture centered on growth, technical excellence, strategic advisory services and accountability across business lines and global regions.


 Emerging Technologies \& Future\-Ready Solutions:
   

  

* Drive innovation and future\-ready solutions across mission\-critical data centres, leveraging advanced technologies, sustainable practices, and integrated digital strategies to ensure resilience, efficiency, and long‑term market leadership in the Middle East


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, or a closely related technical discipline ( Mechanical, Electrical, ICT/Telecoms, Fire \& Life Safety, or similar)
* Master’s degree in engineering management, Business Administration, Data Centre Engineering, or a relevant technical field (preferred
* 15\+ years of experience in mission\-critical/data centre projects, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong understanding of: Data centre MEP/HVAC systems, Electrical redundancy / Tier levels, Uptime Institute standards, Cooling and energy optimisation strategies, Commissioning processes \& operational readiness, Mission‑critical resilience and risk engineering
* Experience working within Middle East regulatory frameworks (UAE/KSA at minimum).
* Proven track record in business development, client management, and P\&L ownership.
* Strong technical understanding of data centre design, construction, and operations.
* Experience leading senior technical experts, sector teams, or multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.


**Core Leadership Capabilities**
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience with P\&L or division\-level budget ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple large\-scale, complex projects simultaneously under aggressive timelines.
* Deep understanding of data center\-specific design considerations, including redundancy factors and industry regulatory frameworks.
* Evidence of building culture, driving accountability, and setting governance structures.

data.jd_text:
**About us** 




 EPAM Systems is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania, EPAM has been helping clients navigate digital transformation for over 30 years, delivering innovative solutions to stay competitive in constantly evolving markets.
 



 As consultants, designers, architects, engineers and trainers, at EPAM, we specialize in building long\-term partnerships, enabling businesses to reimagine themselves through a digital lens. In Saudi Arabia, EPAM operates in Riyadh and Al Khobar, offering cutting\-edge engineering, strategy, design, consulting, and innovation services across industries.
 



  
 



  
 



 We're looking for a
 **Director, Technology Consulting – Telecom SME** 
 to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in a hybrid working mode with onsite client presence in KSA and UAE.
 



 In this senior advisory role, you will act as a trusted partner to telecom clients, helping shape strategies and deliver innovative solutions that enable business transformation and sustainable growth. You will influence high\-impact digital initiatives, manage executive relationships and contribute to building value\-driven propositions that set our clients apart in a competitive market.
 



**The deadline for submission is 15/07/2026\.** 




  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Act as the primary telecom subject matter expert for key clients, ensuring successful delivery and client satisfaction
* Co\-develop account plans and growth strategies in partnership with Account Managers
* Lead business transformation initiatives, product strategy and roadmap development
* Shape and scope complex solutions while defining engagement strategies and delivery governance
* Support contract negotiations and maintain accurate pipeline forecasting for predictable outcomes
* Develop telecom\-focused value propositions, pilot with regional clients and scale globally
* Drive revenue growth across assigned accounts and promote end\-to\-end capabilities of EPAM
* Establish and strengthen senior client relationships to identify additional opportunities
* Deliver against revenue and profitability targets aligned with business objectives
* Stay current with emerging telecom technologies, trends and regulatory dynamics impacting the sector







**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of experience in technology consulting or advisory roles within the telecom domain
* Comprehensive knowledge of B2C, B2B and wholesale models as well as full\-stack implementations (channels/BSS/OSS)
* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise engagements in consulting or IT delivery environments
* Strategic mindset combined with the ability to execute and deliver measurable value
* Deep understanding of platforms, business models and innovations in the telecom sector
* Demonstrated success managing performance metrics across multiple accounts
* Expertise in consulting, strategic planning and solution delivery within large\-scale programs
* Strong network across the Middle East telecom ecosystem, including clients, analysts and partners
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills in Arabic and English
* Familiarity with GenAI technologies and ability to evaluate AI\-driven product opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; MBA or equivalent is an advantage







**Nice to have** 



* Experience in global consulting environments with cross\-functional leadership exposure
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements in the Middle East



  
 



**We offer** 



* General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI)
* Private healthcare and life insurance
* End of service gratuity
* Annual air travel allowance for expatriates
* Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
* Learning and development opportunities including in\-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses



  
 



**Nature of Work and Working Hours** 




 The usual working hours for full\-time roles at EPAM in Saudi Arabia are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one\-hour unpaid lunch break. Working hours may vary based on client requirements and flexibility is accommodated whenever possible.
 



**Our Locations in Saudi Arabia** 




**Riyadh** 
 \- Moon Tower, Mezzanine Floor, King Fahed Branch Road, AR Rahmaniyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



**Al Khobar** 
 \- 21st Floor, Khobar Gate Tower, Al Bandariyah District, King Fahd Road, Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
 



**How to Apply, Recruitment Process and Deadline** 




 If you meet the requirements and are eager to join EPAM, simply submit your application online by clicking on "apply” and providing your up to date CV and/or LinkedIn profile and other optional materials live cover letters and portfolios.
 



 Once applied, you will have a conversation with our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a technical interview and an interview with the hiring manager; a client interview may also be included in some cases. If successful, you'll receive an offer and, upon acceptance, officially become part of our team. We look forward to welcoming you aboard!
 



 Join EPAM today and contribute to shaping the future of technology while growing your career in a supportive, global work environment.
