data.jd_text:
The Director of Supply Chain leads end\-to\-end supply chain strategy and operations, from procurement and vendor management through warehousing, inventory, and logistics. The role carries full ownership of the department’s budget, KPIs, and team, with significant influence over cost efficiency and service levels across the organization. It requires deep supply chain expertise, strong commercial and negotiation skills, and the leadership presence to manage a multi\-disciplinary team and a broad network of external partners
 



  




1. **Key Responsibilities:**


* Set the supply chain department’s strategy, goals, budgets, and KPIs in alignment with divisional and organizational objectives.
* Develop supply chain policies and ensure the processes and procedures are in place to execute them effectively.
* Monitor and control supply chain expenditures against approved budget and reconcile budget variances to ensure on\-target performance against budgets.
* Directs and coordinates supply chain functions through strategy, resource optimization, profitability maximization, and KPIs resulting in the maximization of customer satisfaction.
* Select and manage relationships with suppliers, vendors, warehouse service providers and clearing agents.
* Work with 3rd party service providers to ensure achievement of cost, accuracy, and timeliness objectives.
* Review and manage contracts with 3rd party service providers, identify non\-compliance and take necessary action as required.
* Partner with key stakeholders and users to understand current and future business needs, identify business process changes and opportunities for improvement
* Ensure reconciliation of physical stock with the system, in case of discrepancy work with people concerned to reconcile it.
* Manage the inventory team and stock taking activities to ensure the accuracy and availability of the products in MP’s storages.
* Supervise and ensure receipt of goods on time, assist in customs clearance as and when required.
* Collaborate with other departments to reduce landed costs through efficient demand planning and accuracy.
* Ensure the provision of tendering services, including preparation of RFIs and RFP templates, liaising with bidders on documentation, receiving and documentation of bids, commercial evaluation and negotiation of bids, preparation of presentations to the Tender Committee, and communication of award to suppliers
* Assist end users in post\-award resolution of commercial issues in coordination with Legal Affairs
* Manage the performance of the cost benchmarking exercise.
* Ensure that project cost schedules are in\-line with MP’s benchmarks to ensure best\-value for money for all services and material procurement.
* Assist in the performance of other special duties and projects as needed in support of organizational goals.



 This position is Reserved for Qatari Nationals
 



**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in operations or supply chain management or equivalent
 



 ● CSCP, CPSM and other relevant certifications preferred and desired
 



**Experience** 
 :
 



 ● Minimum 15 years of experience in a supply chain managerial role preferably in the GCC.
 



 ● Knowledge of the local laws, regulations, and business landscape.

**Manages Cross\-functional team of full\-stack developers (backend \+ frontend \+ mobile) across multiple product areas** 




  





**About the role** 




 We run multiple product areas on a shared microservices platform. You will own end\-to\-end delivery, architecture, and code quality for your assigned product areas, run their squads, and represent them in cross\-product platform decisions.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Lead a squad of 5–10 engineers (backend, frontend, mobile) across your assigned product areas sprint planning, design reviews, PR reviews, 1:1s, performance management.
 



 • Own architecture decisions inside your product areas and partner with other Tech Leads and the Head of Technology on platform\-wide concerns (shared auth, common backend, mobile app, analytics pipeline).
 



 • Set engineering quality bars: PR review standards, branching / cherry\-pick discipline between QA and production, test coverage, migration safety, incident response.
 



 • Drive technical roadmap conversion from product requirements — break down work, estimate, sequence, ship.
 



 • Be hands\-on: write code on critical paths, unblock the team, prototype risky changes yourself, ship hotfixes.
 



 • Run incident response for production issues in your product areas — root\-cause analysis, post\-mortems, prevention.
 



  





**Must\-have experience** 




 • 7\+ years building production web platforms; 2\+ years leading engineering teams.
 



 • NestJS monorepos (apps \+ libs structure) — multiple apps per service sharing typed libs.
 



 • Next.js App Router with server components, ISR / SSR, dynamic routes.
 



 • TypeScript end\-to\-end (strict mode), modern React (hooks, MUI, Tailwind).
 



 • PostgreSQL at scale — schema design, indexing, query optimisation, Sequelize ORM, migration discipline. Familiarity with Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL for distributed workloads is a plus.
 



 • Search platforms — Azure AI Search (scoring profiles, semantic configurations, synonym maps) and / or Elasticsearch (mappings, aggregations, dashboards).
 



 • Azure application platform: Container Apps, App Services, Function Apps, Service Bus, Storage Blob, Front Door.
 



 • CI/CD on Azure DevOps Pipelines — build → ACR push → container app update; cherry\-pick workflows for promoting QA → production.
 



 • AI integration experience — Azure OpenAI (chat, embeddings), prompt design, structured JSON response\_format, retries / fallbacks.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 • Marketplace / multi\-vertical platform experience.
 



 • Mobile app delivery (Flutter or React Native) — Android \+ iOS.
 



 • BullMQ / queue\-based async processing.
 



 • Multi\-tenant / B2B subscription / quota systems.
 



 • Regional payment integrations.
 



 • Moderation systems (Implio or similar).
 



 • ERP integration (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics 365\).
 



 • Third\-party ATS / recruitment integrations (e.g. Zoho Recruit).

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a highly technical, execution\-focused Product Delivery Lead to bridge the gap between closed sales and active customer success. In this role, you will own the critical onboarding phase, ensuring that new enterprise customers are seamlessly integrated into our SaaS platform despite having highly specific, complex data requirements.
   

  

 You will be the orchestrator who turns a signed contract into active, AI\-driven value. By combining a deep understanding of our product portfolio with expertise in data ingestion techniques and ontology mapping, you will eliminate friction in the setup process. Your ultimate goal is to accelerate the "Time\-to\-Value" for our customers, ensuring they can leverage our Agentic AI tools and sustainability solutions as quickly and effortlessly as possible.
   

  

**Jobs To Be Done**
* Lead the end\-to\-end technical onboarding and implementation of our SaaS solutions for new enterprise customers.
* Serve as the primary bridge between the customer's technical teams and our internal engineering/data teams to define and execute data ingestion strategies.
* Manage complex data requirements, including leading ontology mapping exercises to ensure customer data seamlessly aligns with our AI models.
* Develop, manage, and execute detailed delivery project plans, ensuring timelines, milestones, and customer expectations are consistently met.
* Partner closely with the Business Developer to ensure a smooth handover from the sales cycle and align on strategic customer goals.
* Create repeatable, scalable onboarding playbooks to continuously reduce friction and speed up the delivery lifecycle for future customers.
* Troubleshoot early\-stage data integration roadblocks, ensuring a frictionless transition into "business\-as\-usual" platform usage.


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Scrum Master) are highly valued.
* Bonus points for certifications or coursework in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or Database Management.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in technical delivery, SaaS implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management.
* Proven track record of successfully onboarding B2B enterprise customers with heavy data integration requirements.
* Hands\-on experience navigating data ingestion pipelines, APIs, ETL processes, and complex data mapping/ontology mapping.
* Experience working alongside sales or business development teams in a fast\-paced, high\-growth tech environment.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Delivery Management: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to herd cats, manage scope creep, and keep complex deployments strictly on schedule.
* Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of how data flows between systems. You don't need to write the code, but you must confidently discuss APIs, data ingestion, and ontology mapping with engineers.
* Product Mastery: Rapid ability to deeply understand our entire product portfolio and how different modules interact with customer data.
* Client Management: Excellent executive presence and communication skills. You can translate highly technical data requirements into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: A proactive, "fix\-it\-first" mentality when dealing with data integration bottlenecks.


**KPIs**
* Time\-to\-Value (TTV): Reduction in the average number of days from contract signature to the customer's first successful use of AI insights.
* Onboarding Success Rate: Percentage of customer implementations delivered on time and within scope.
* Data Integration Efficiency: Reduction in manual interventions or rework required during the data mapping and ingestion phases.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): High satisfaction scores specifically tied to the onboarding and delivery experience.
* Playbook Adoption: Successful creation and internal adoption of standardized delivery processes.


**Why Us**
 As a Product Delivery Lead, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of AI for sustainability and drive meaningful impact in the global energy sector. You will work alongside a passionate, mission\-driven team and play a pivotal role in delivering innovative, disruptive solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges.
   

  

**Mobility Information**
 Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country.
   

  

**Job Posting End Date**
 julio\-31\-2026

This position drives focused efforts to provide technical solutions to the business, ensure high operational quality, and achieve strategic objectives related to customer acquisition and retention.
   

  

 The role also supports the growth of the brand within the Aerospace market and contributes to achieving service delivery targets. In addition, it is responsible for managing integrated technical and operational solutions in close collaboration with business units and functional areas such as Finance and Customer Solutions.
   

  

 The ultimate aim is to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and recognition, while creating mutual and sustainable value.
   

  

**How you create impact**

* Solid exposure to international environments and cross\-border operations.Initial leadership experience (direct and/or virtual), with the ability to work within a matrix organization.

 You will have the opportunity to take ownership of a critical aerospace logistics function within a global organization, working in a dynamic and international environment.  As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference.

**Overview**
 University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Emiri Decision No13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST has over 70 bachelor's and master's degree programs, diplomas, and certificates. The university houses 5 colleges: The College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, in addition to specialized training centers for individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Its world\-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well\-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.
   

  

 With more than 700 staff and over 8,000 students, UDST is the destination of choice for applied and experiential learning. The University is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Our faculty are committed to delivering pedagogically\-sound learning experiences that incorporate innovative learning technologies. Our aim is to enhance students’ skills and help develop talented graduates who can effectively contribute to a knowledge\-based economy and make Qatar’s National Vision 2030 a reality.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will support the development of the Information Division’s business plan in alignment with UDST strategy and future technology needs through its projects and initiatives.
   

  

 Operational:
   

  

 Service Desk Management: Oversee the University's IT service desk operations, ensuring timely and effective response to user inquiries and technical issues while monitoring service levels, response times, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Incident Resolution: Streamline operational procedures and employ proactive problem\-solving strategies to accelerate the timely and accurate resolution of IT incidents and service requests, minimizing user disruption while identifying trends and root causes to implement preventive measures.
   

  

 User Training and Self\-Help Resources: Develop and deliver training sessions and resources to empower users to resolve common technical issues independently and maintain a knowledge base of solutions and troubleshooting guides.
   

  

 Vendor and Contract Management: Strategically partner with vendors and service providers to resolve escalated technical issues and manage service agreements and procure hardware, software and services required for IT support.
   

  

 Continuous Improvement: Challenge the status quo of support processes, identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of support services.
   

  

 User Communication: Establish relationship with University stakeholders to engage and communicate effectively on updates on service disruptions, maintenance, technical issues and manage user expectations and maintain a high level of customer service.
   

  

 Budgeting and Resource Allocation: Manage the IT Support sections’ budget, allocating resources for staffing, training, tools, and equipment to optimize resource utilization to meet user needs and service levels.
   

  

 Documentation and Reporting: Safeguard critical records of incidents, service requests and resolutions to enable decision\-making by tracking performance, trends and user feedback.
   

  

 Perform miscellaneous job\-related duties as assigned.
   

  

 Provide professional development support and perform periodic performance reviews for direct subordinates based on UDST’s Employee Performance Management framework to ensure continual high performance of employees in alignment with UDST's mission and mandate.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required.
* Master’s degree/ professional certification is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in IT in a Higher Education Institutes.
* Fluency in written and spoken English language is required.
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic language is preferred.

**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 The Superintendent Construction role requires an in\-depth understanding of project execution strategies, workforce management theories, and Construction principles, with a basic knowledge of related disciplines. The Superintendent Construction must be able to apply industry insights to enhance on\-site productivity, provide leadership, and influence processes and policies for effective workforce governance, as well as identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational problems that impact project outcomes. The Superintendent Construction’s decisions are pivotal in ensuring that the team meets its objectives with efficiency and adherence to safety standards. These decisions should be guided by established policies, resource allocations, budget considerations, and the overarching project plan.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Direct and manage fabrication construction activities, ensuring they are executed in line with project specifications, schedules, and company standards
* Liaise with project management and engineering teams to coordinate project phases and resources
* Uphold the highest safety standards, implementing and enforcing comprehensive HSE protocols to maintain a zero\-incident workplace
* Guarantee quality control throughout construction processes, ensuring compliance with industry codes and project quality requirements
* Optimize the use of resources, including workforce scheduling, equipment allocation, and material procurement, to meet project objectives
* Supervise subcontractors and vendors, ensuring their performance meets contractual agreements and project standards
* Maintain accurate and comprehensive project documentation and provide timely progress updates to stakeholders
* Foster a culture of teamwork and continuous improvement, mentoring staff, and promoting skill development within the construction team
* Interface and share a common planning with all the discipline in the project to have a clear target plan
* Discuss the planning of the activities for the next 4 weeks and assign the people based on that creating and MLF that could bring productivity to 1 or above
* Own and lead the implementation, enforcement, and verification of compliance with all McDermott policies and procedures
* Ensure employees understand their responsibility and authority to effectively implement the requirements of all McDermott policies and procedures
* Ensure the timely completion of all mandatory training by themselves and their teams


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline, with advanced industry\-specific certifications desirable
* Extensive experience in the EPCI industry, with a significant portion in a leadership role overseeing fabrication construction projects
* Profound knowledge of modern fabrication techniques and standards relevant to the construction and EPCI sectors
* Demonstrated ability to manage HSE systems effectively, with certifications in occupational health and safety preferred
* Strong leadership capabilities with a proven track record of effectively managing diverse construction teams
* Excellent communication skills, adept at negotiating with clients and managing stakeholder expectations
* Resilient problem\-solving skills, capable of addressing complex challenges in a dynamic project environment
* Willingness to work in various geographic locations and adaptability to extended hours or shift work as project demands dictate


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are:** 




  





 Técnicas Reunidas (TR) is a leading international engineering and construction company in the energy sector, with more than 65 years of experience and over 13,000 professionals worldwide. We have our headquarters in Madrid, offices in Bilbao and Cartagena, and engineering centers in India, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Chile, among others, offering career opportunities in an international environment. Our commitment to people has been recognized with the Top Employer certification in Spain and India.
 



  





**Global Projects and the Energy of the Future** 
 :
 



  





 At TR, we develop projects in Oil \& Gas and Power, and we are advancing toward the energy of the future through hydrogen, clean fuels, and carbon capture projects, integrating digitalization, AI, and robotics. Our high level of professionalism and commitment drives continuous research to improve efficiency and sustainability, always in strict compliance with the law and aligned with the highest ethical standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Steel Structure Superintendent leads and coordinates the construction activities of a Steel Structure performed by Subcontractors, with the support of Construction Supervisors, generally assigned by area. He will act mainly at the Subcontractor's interface, leading him to perform his scope of work on budget, schedule and with the required quality and compliance of HSE standards.
 



 Steel Structure Superintendent maintains a proper interface with the rest of Disciplines, not only with the Construction ones but also with Engineering and Procurement to solve any matter affecting Steel Structure works at Site.
 



 Based on above points, Steel Structure Superintendent is the first responsible for the timely completion of the construction works, ensuring while Project is constructed in strict accordance with approved execution plan. Conflicts or revisions to this plan shall be immediately communicated to the Project team for mutual resolution.
 



  





**Main functions:** 




  




* Review the last revision of IFC drawings, Engineering Instructions and method of statements, along with Steel Structure schedule, to properly supervise the works at Site and ensure that construction activities are done on schedule, quality and cost.
* Arrange with the Subcontractor the corresponding weekly meetings to validate and consolidate the week ahead activities to be performed. The Steel Structure Superintendent shall keep always updated the weekly plan against the overall Project schedule with full knowledge about the current Workfront.
* Assist the Planning and Production Control Departments to update the current Steel Structure plan or to develop a new forecast plan revision.
* Check that the Steel Structure Supervisors are aware about the Subcontractor scope of work and that the daily targets are fixed according with Project schedule. The Steel Structure Superintendent shall distribute the workload between the Supervisors based on the weekly targets.
* Ensure that the daily production is evaluated by every Steel Structure Supervisor and it is daily loaded in the system. Demand the corresponding clarifications to the Supervisors to avoid discrepancies with Planning Department and ensure the reliability and readiness of the progress declared by the Subcontractor.
* Evaluate the Steel Structure Supervisor performance, enhancing their skills and abilities. Organize workflow and ensure that employees understand their duties or delegated tasks. Dismiss Steel Structure Supervisors who fail to meet expectations under justified arguments.
* Check with Steel Structure Supervisors that the adequate Subcontractor manpower is available for each task and the labour force allocated on the job is productively used.
* Steel Structure Supervisors will know the Steel Structure corporate tools and procedures, and he will use and apply them in the daily work. Report the manpower deployed at Site in a daily basis.
* Check in advance with Subcontractor that required tools and worksite access (scaffolding, roads, etc.) are available to perform the planned daily activities.
* Manage the material dispatched to the Subcontractor and ensure its efficient use. Identify proper methods of material handling and preservation to prevent damages or deterioration. Minimize as much as possible the site storages period.
* Provide on\-site coordination with Subcontractor, walk daily all work areas to monitor activities. Validate the FEWOs and contribute with the corresponding information to issue the reliable evidences.
* If applicable, verify and follow up the compliance and filling of the Work Time Sheets by the Steel Structure Supervisors, demanding full accuracy over the hours required to perform the activity.
* If applicable, validate and follow up the required Vendor assistance man\-hours to minimize them for the contractual ones. In no case, the Vendor technician will cover the function and responsibilities of Supervisors because of their negligence or lack of skill/knowledge.
* The Steel Structure Superintendent does not have authorization to be engaged in commercial agreements (subcontracts, change orders, work authorizations). However, he should provide the necessary support to Subcontract Department to identify the Subcontractor deficiencies and negligence of its functions. Ensure that Subcontractor is fully executing and complying with his contractual scope of work.
* Undertake actively the discussions, technical queries and site agreements with Engineering / Client to prevent common topics (accessibility, typical, etc.) suffered in previous Projects as to increase production and reduce reworks.
* Ensure that any red\-marked drawing provided by Subcontractor include all changes exactly as it was built. Implement and know the ITPs, and any other TR procedure and make them effective at Site.
* Steel Structure Superintendent shall follow up the site quality control programs to ensure quality completion of construction. He will promote mock\-up and toolbox with Subcontractor, Supervisors and Quality Inspectors before starting up a new construction activity to make sure everybody understands and is aligned with the applicable Project Specifications, Standards and Method of Statements.
* Prevent making goods by the corresponding checkpoints inspections conducted by the QC/Supervisors and demand to the Supervisor team his ownership on this issue.
* As a maximum responsible at Site in his Discipline, he shall keep clean and organize the unit/work area in compliance with HSE and good practices.
* He will be proactively involved in the HSE programs and campaigns to create a HSE culture in his Subcontractor and Supervisor team.
* Coordinate and focus the work towards the Mechanical Completion of the plant in line with the PMCs and the commissioning priorities, once agreed with the Construction Manager.
* Supervise the close out of the Steel Structure punches by Subcontractor during the handover stage.
* Encourage the Supervisors to collect and report the LL during the Project execution for him to load them in the corporate LL application.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil, Structural, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of construction experience, including at least 7\-10 years in Steel Structure Supervision or Superintendent roles.
* Extensive experience in structural steel erection, fabrication, installation, alignment, and bolting activities.
* Experience on EPC projects within Oil \& Gas, LNG, Petrochemical, Power Plant, or Industrial Construction sectors.
* Experience supervising subcontractors, construction supervisors, and multidisciplinary site teams.
* Ability to coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Quality, Commissioning, and Client representatives.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work in multicultural environments and manage multiple priorities under tight project schedules.
* Fluent in English.

 Integration Coordination and Support

* Assist with cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and transition\-to\-support activities to help ensure integrated solutions are deployed and stabilised smoothly


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Capture post\-implementation observations, lessons learned, and service performance insights, and share these with the Product Integration Manager to support continuous improvement in integration delivery
* Contribute to team knowledge by maintaining up\-to\-date records, sharing delivery insights, and identifying opportunities to improve integration coordination processes

* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.

data.raw_snippet:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for proactively managing QNB Group’s selected Corporate Banking portfolio, Branches and affiliates (the “Selected Portfolio”) in order to achieve the function’s set targets for revenue, profit, profitability and volumes, in compliance with established QNB Group credit policies, procedures, standards, regulatory requirements and best international market practice.
   

  

 The individual will also be involved in the formulation of corporate branch strategies and the implementation of the GCIB initiatives (including GWB and GAM) across his portfolio. As well as, identify potential new business opportunities for other business area functions or branches within the QNB Group, aligned to the approved Global Account Management concept and co\-ordinate with them to facilitate Group synergies and cross selling of products and services. To improve QNB’s profitability, revenue generation as well as service and delivery enhancement, in order to ensure that clients banking’ needs are comprehensively identified and efficiently met, within the QNB Group, on a priority basis.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, and profit targets for the Selected Portfolio function.
* Support the EVP International Corporate in the development of Key Performance Indicators for the systematic performance monitoring, quality measurement and performance evaluation of the Selected Portfolio function
* Meet target budgets for Selected Portfolio’s client relationships comprising assets and liability product sales and profits for the Selected Portfolio function, in accordance with QNB’s overall corporate budget and strategy.
* Coordinate periodically between Selected Portfolio, Group’s corporate branches network and subsidiaries to review financial performance and ensure achievement of budget and financial objectives
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for International Corporate Relationship Management.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Coordinate and liaise activities with international and regional Branches, Retail, Treasury and Head Office support functions including but not limited to GSF and GTB, QNB Capital and QNBFS (“QNB Functions”) to provide support and cross selling opportunities intra QNB Group departments, units and functions.
* Ensure provision of a focal ‘one point of contact’ to Selected Portfolio of clients and ensure superior customer service and a customer friendly approach to proactively meet their needs and resolve their queries.
* Assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.
* Maintain, develop and enhance core bank relationships with the existing clients as well as identify, market and build effective new bank relationships.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with QNB Functions in order to achieve the QNB Group’s goals and objectives, including cross\-selling targets.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Group’s compliance function when required.
* Implement the approved corporate banking strategy within the function to achieve and exceed the business objectives.
* Maintain, conduct and ensure that activities of the Selected Portfolio comply with regulatory policies and procedures and best market practice.
* Manage, coach and motivate the team of Selected Portfolio’s VPs, AVPs, Managers and Associates to maintain and improve service quality and ensure that the Selected Portfolio meets their set financial and non\-financial targets.
* Continuously monitor, manage and evaluate the Selected Portfolio credit profile to ensure targets are met and any necessary corrective measures are implemented on a timely basis, as required. The portfolio should be managed in accordance within the Bank’s prescribed risk management parameters.
* Review, conduct due diligence and credit assessment, and recommend approval of credit proposals to the relevant approving authority.
* Ensure each VP International Corporate Relationship management has a balanced portfolio and continuously monitor to ensure that each portfolio is destined to achieve its set target and, if appropriate, take corrective action to redirect portfolio management if there is insufficient progress towards the achievement of its set target.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to Selected Portfolio’s VPs and AVPs to ensure their credit proposals adequately address all relevant risk factors and meet minimum acceptable standards.
* Monitor / develop the Selected Portfolio function’s database ensuring that function personnel perform sales activity in accordance with incumbent’s directives and timely update the database of client contacts.
* Perform / assign function personnel to systematically visit client premises, conduct meetings and prepare / deliver presentations.
* Ensure that all requisite facility and account documentation are collected by function personnel and are timely transferred for credit review and safe custody.
* Ensure all necessary procedures are in place to identify and timely report any customer related negative developments and early signals regarding potentially problematic accounts / relationships and ensure that suitable remedial action is taken by function personnel.
* Ensure that function’s personnel perform cross selling activities to enhance QNB’s overall relationship with customers by coordinating activities with QNB Functions.
* Supervise the roll\-out of conventional corporate banking products targeted to Selected Portfolio clients.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with key managers of existing and potential clients to provide a broader range of communication, service consistency and proactive response to client’s needs.
* Work in liaison with Group Communications and the Marketing \& Product Management Unit to devise Selected Portfolio specific marketing strategies, client target lists etc. to defend and increase QNB’s current market share.
* Track and report on transaction volumes, budget performance and client\-wise overall portfolio profitability and periodically report to EVP International Corporate and to other executive management of the Group to assess the performance of the Selected Portfolio customer base, as requested.
* Recommend all administrative operational aspects of unit personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Oversee recruitment, provide motivation, guidance to employees and reinforce high standards concerning performance, and adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in in the banking industry, preferably with local / gulf / regional responsibility (dependent on the portfolio coverage) experience. Masters preferred
* At least 15 years’ experience of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structures, industry practices and any regulations relevant to regional and International Corporate clients segment.
* Informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and compliance and regulatory requirements of Selected Portfolio countries.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills (including report writing) in English and Arabic.
* Excellent people relationship skills and awareness of risk management concept and practices.
* Understanding of the relevant laws, regulations and practices pertaining to Corporate Banking products.
* Ability to make decisions and follow through with initiatives.
* Personal integrity and self\-management.
* Planning, organizing, and analytical ability.
* Results oriented.
* Ability to motivate and lead teams from diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Familiar with the balanced scorecard approach.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of management.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
Chief Investment Officer (Confidential)
 



**Location:** 
 Doha, Qatar
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



 We are conducting a confidential search for an exceptional Chief Investment Officer to lead the investment strategy, investment platform, product innovation, and capital markets activities of a rapidly growing investment business.
 



  





 This is not a traditional portfolio management role.
 



 The successful candidate will combine institutional investment expertise with commercial leadership, bringing the ability to design investment products, originate investment opportunities, raise institutional capital, and build scalable investment platforms serving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth clients.
 



 The CIO will play a central role in shaping the firm's future investment strategy while partnering closely with Executive Management and the Board to drive long\-term growth.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership
* Develop and execute the firm's investment strategy across public and private markets.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction across multiple asset classes.
* Provide investment recommendations to Executive Management, Investment Committee and Board.



  





 Develop investment policies, governance frameworks and portfolio risk management processes.
 



 Monitor macroeconomic developments, capital markets and emerging investment opportunities globally.
 



  





 Investment Platform \& Product Development
 



 Lead the development, structuring and launch of institutional investment products.
 



 Design and oversee:
 


* Listed investment funds
* Private investment funds
* Alternative investment funds
* SMAs
* Co\-investment platforms
* Structured products
* Bespoke institutional mandates
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Distribution to successfully commercialize investment solutions.
* Develop differentiated investment propositions for institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, family offices and UHNW clients.
* Partner with distribution teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor presentations and product positioning.



  





 Investment Origination \& Transaction Execution
 



 Lead the sourcing and execution of investment opportunities across multiple asset classes
 



  





 Oversee:
 


* Financial modelling
* Valuation
* Commercial analysis
* Due diligence
* Investment Committee papers
* Transaction structuring
* Negotiations
* Execution



  





 Coordinate external advisors including investment banks, legal counsel, consultants and placement agents.
 



  





 Institutional Capital \& Commercial Leadership
 



 Develop long\-term relationships with:
 


* Sovereign Wealth Funds
* Pension Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Family Offices
* Institutional Asset Managers
* Banks
* Development Finance Institutions
* Strategic Partners



  





 Support capital raising initiatives through strong institutional engagement.
 



 Represent the firm with investors, regulators and industry stakeholders.
 



 Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform.
 



  





 Leadership
 


* Build and lead a high\-performing investment organization.
* Develop investment professionals across research, portfolio management, product development and investment execution.
* Promote a culture of disciplined investment decision\-making, innovation, collaboration and commercial excellence.
* Serve as the principal investment adviser to Executive Management and the Board.



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across most of the following areas:
 



 Investment Leadership
 


* Leading multi\-asset investment strategies
* Strategic and tactical asset allocation
* Investment Committee leadership
* Portfolio construction
* Investment governance
* Risk management



  





 Listed Funds
 


* Demonstrated experience managing, overseeing or launching listed investment funds or publicly traded investment vehicles.
* Investment Product Development
* Hands\-on experience designing, structuring and launching investment products including institutional funds, alternative investment vehicles, SMAs, structured products or bespoke client mandates.



  





 Asset Class Experience
 



 Strong experience across several of the following:
 


* Public Equities
* Fixed Income
* Private Equity
* Private Credit
* Infrastructure
* Real Estate
* Venture Capital
* Structured Products
* Hedge Funds
* Alternatives
* Multi\-Asset Portfolios



  





 Breadth of experience across multiple asset classes is considered highly desirable.
 



 Sector Experience
 



  





 Experience investing across multiple sectors including, but not limited to:
 


* Financial Services
* Infrastructure
* Energy
* Industrials
* Technology
* Healthcare
* Consumer
* Real Estate
* Aviation
* Logistics
* Telecommunications



  





 Candidates with broad cross\-sector investment experience will be preferred.
 



  





 Commercial Capability
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to combine investment excellence with commercial execution through:
 


* Investment origination
* Product commercialization
* Institutional fundraising
* Client engagement
* Strategic partnerships
* Business development



  





 Candidates coming from primarily buy\-side backgrounds should be able to demonstrate why their experience equips them to successfully lead a commercially focused investment platform with strong institutional client engagement and product development responsibilities.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline
* MBA or Master's degree preferred
* CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualification highly desirable
* 15\+ years of relevant investment experience
* Proven experience in institutional investment management, investment banking, capital markets, private markets or alternative investments
* Experience presenting to Boards and Investment Committees
* Strong institutional network across global investors



  





 Critical Competencies
 


* Multi\-Asset Investment Strategy
* Investment Product Innovation
* Listed \& Private Fund Management
* Capital Markets
* Investment Banking
* Institutional Capital Raising
* Investment Origination
* Portfolio Construction
* Financial Modelling
* Transaction Structuring
* Investment Governance
* Commercial Leadership
* Institutional Relationship Management
* Team Leadership



  





 Ideal Background
 



 Candidates are likely to come from positions such as:
 


* Chief Investment Officer
* Deputy Chief Investment Officer
* Global Head of Investment Solutions
* Global Head of Multi\-Asset
* Managing Director – Investment Banking
* Managing Director – Capital Markets
* Managing Director – Infrastructure \& Real Assets
* Head of Institutional Investments
* Head of Alternatives
* Head of Product \& Investment Solutions
* Head of Private Markets
* Head of Asset Management
* Senior Portfolio Manager (Institutional)
* Head of Investment Products
* Partner – Private Equity or Infrastructure
* Managing Director – Structured Finance
* Head of Institutional Capital Markets



  





 What We Will Be Looking For
 



 During the selection process, candidates will be expected to demonstrate:
 


* Experience managing or overseeing listed investment funds.
* A proven track record in designing and launching investment products.
* Breadth of investment experience across multiple asset classes.
* Cross\-sector investment expertise.
* The ability to transition investment expertise into a commercially driven investment platform focused on institutional clients, product innovation, and capital formation.

data.jd_text:
**If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, take a look at the possibilities right on your doorstep here at HSBC.**
 HSBC Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
   

  

**The Role**
 HSBC’s Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB) – International Mid\-Market (IMM) team in Qatar is looking for a high\-performing Relationship Director to manage and grow a portfolio of internationally minded Corporates and with revenues from $100m to over $2bn.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to clients with cross\-border ambitions, connecting them to HSBC’s international network and full suite of corporate banking solutions.
   

  

**In This Role You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Growing and deepening client relationships
+ Expand existing IMM relationships and originate new\-to\-bank opportunities aligned to HSBC’s international strategy.

* Be a strategic advisor
+ Provide consultative insights to help clients navigate complex cross\-border and global market dynamics.

* Own the client experience
+ Deliver best\-in\-class service and act as a senior escalation point for client needs.

* Drive sustainable revenue growth
+ Partner with product specialists (e.g., Treasury \& Cash Management, Trade, FX, Lending/Debt solutions) and colleagues across HSBC’s global network to increase HSBC’s share of the client’s global wallet.

* Lead credit and risk discipline
+ Credit assessment, deal structuring, approvals support, and ongoing monitoring across the portfolio.

* Manage operational, regulatory and financial crime risk
+ Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and external regulations.

* Build networks and market profile
+ Strengthen internal connectivity and enhance HSBC’s presence in the local business community and with professional intermediaries.


**What You’ll Need (minimum Requirements)**
* Bachelor’s degree is required to obtain a work permit.
* 10\+ years’ experience in Corporate/Commercial Banking or Financial Services with relationship management accountability.
* Strong knowledge of corporate banking products: cash management, trade, FX, lending/structured solutions.
* Solid credit and lending experience, including complex facilities and risk assessment.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to collaborate across product and risk teams.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills.
* Client\-centric mindset, commercial acumen, and ability to deliver in a fast\-moving environment.


 For further details and application information please visit our careers site.
   

  

 We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Job Description**
 The position of Director of Engineering is responsible for the efficient operation of the hotel property and all its equipment, ancillary maintenance and repair services and protection of the Owner’s asset. Structural aspects of the hotel as well as the maintenance of grounds and external facilities all fall within the span of responsibility.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
 Responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:
   

  

* Provide advice to senior management on all aspects of engineering support, environmental controls and the operational efficiency of the property.
* Ensure the effective financial management of the engineering department by setting maintenance budgets, capital works programs and engineering plans and ensuring that performance against these are regularly monitored and reviewed. Responsible for the general cost control aspects of maintenance, the preparation of departmental cost budgets and their implementation and submission to management.
* Control of Capital Project Planning, in liaison with management, to ensure capital funding is effectively allocated and budgeted in accordance with company directives and philosophy.
* Plan, implement and administer an energy management program by establishing energy reduction objectives, the maintenance of records and regular reporting of performance against these objectives.
* Ensure the colleagues awareness of energy management within the property by conducting regular education and training programs on energy conservation and matters related to efficient operation of equipment in a cost\-effective fashion.
* Contribute to the hotel’s profitability by ensuring the effective management of the buildings environmental controls and energy conservation systems. Evaluate, control and record energy usage and implement and upgrade energy conservation systems.
* Contribute to guest satisfaction standards by ensuring that technical support services quickly address, and where possible, anticipate, individual needs. Ensure the safety and comfort of guests, and that any requests for service are handled in a courteous and efficient fashion.
* Ensure adherence to all statutory regulations and fire codes by regularly reviewing policies and safety procedures. Ensure that any tests and inspections required on plant by statutory authorities are carried out as and when required and that all records and documentation associated with such tests and surveys are correctly kept and/or displayed. Ensure that the hotel fulfills all compliance requirements.
* Ensure technically competent engineering colleagues by selecting, training and developing a motivated, well\-qualified maintenance team. Carry out regular work sampling studies within the department and evaluate the performance and productivity of personnel.
* Maintain the condition of the physical assets of the hotel by carrying out any upgrading and project work in liaison with architects, interior designers and management.
* Ensure the effective operation of all the mechanical and electrical systems and equipment by implementing and managing a preventative maintenance program. Closely monitor the condition of the physical property and equipment by conducting continual inspections of the building. Ensure that preventative maintenance schedules are in operation and regularly upgraded.
* Contribute to a high standard of quality control within the hotel.
* Closely supervise outside contractors to ensure the cost effectiveness and the technical efficiency of all services performed. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with contracts, leases, service agreements and warranties.
* Ensure the quality of all work completed by both employees and external contracted colleagues adheres to the standards of good engineering practice.
* Contribute to the effectiveness of management decision making by representing the engineering department at all executive and colleagues meetings and by ensuring regular liaison with heads of other departments.


**Qualifications**
* Experience managing large and complex hotel assets, ideally within premium properties
* Strong technical knowledge across HVAC, electrical, plumbing, BMS and fire/life safety systems
* Demonstrated experience leading CAPEX projects,
* Strong understanding of WHS legislation, statutory compliance and building regulations
* Excellent contractor, stakeholder and project management capabilities
* Exceptional leadership, communication and problem\-solving skills
* A proactive, solutions\-focused mindset with strong commercial acumen
* Qualifications in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering or a related discipline are highly regarded
* Knowledge of sustainability practices and energy management systems
* Experience working within heritage or highly regulated environments is advantageous


 Additional Information
   

  

* Opportunity to join the first Raffles in Bahrain
* Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
* Learning programs through our Academies
* Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
* Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 This role will be part of Zain Bahrain's Subsidiary Fintech Company \- "Bede"
   

  

 Bede, the fintech arm of Zain Bahrain, is a dynamic startup revolutionizing personal finance through Bahrain’s first Shariah\-compliant Islamic financing app. Licensed and regulated by the Central Bank of Bahrain, Bede is committed to creating an inclusive platform that offers practical solutions tailored to real customer needs.
   

  

 With a focus on customer centricity, strategic partnerships, and digital innovation, Bede aims to guide individuals toward growth and success by leveling the playing field for all. Bede
   

  

 The Finance Manager will be overall responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, management, and running of all finance activities for Bede, including business planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and financial operations, as well as providing commercial insight and recommendations across the business to achieve business plan targets. The role covers Bede’s full product portfolio — including microfinance, credit cards, remittances, and future products such as insurance, investment, and wallet services — reporting jointly to the Bede CEO and the Zain Bahrain CFO.
   

  

 The role is accountable for sound financial management, regulatory compliance with Central Bank of Bahrain requirements, and providing data\-driven insight to support business decision\-making. Working closely with Business, Technology, and Operations teams, the Finance Manager will evaluate product\-level financial performance, optimize costs, assess technology and app investment opportunities, and support the growth of Bede’s finance function as the business scales.
   

  

 What We Need From You
   

  

* BSc/BA in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant field; a professional accounting qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or CMA) is required.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning \& analysis, or a related field, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services.
* Proven track record in budgeting, financial performance review, and cost management within a fast\-paced or growth\-stage business.
* Experience working with or alongside product teams to assess financial viability of new products or features is a strong advantage.
* Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory reporting experience and exposure to ERP system integrations are strong advantages.


**Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Controls
* Manage all financial aspects of Bede, including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and reporting.
* Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and controls to ensure proper financial management and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Lead the annual and monthly budgeting process, working with the Director of Business and product/function leads to build realistic, achievable financial plans.
* Conduct regular business performance reviews, tracking actual results against budget across all products and functions, and reporting variances with clear commentary.
* Strategic Planning \& Commercial Insight
* Collaborate with the senior management team to develop and implement Bede’s financial strategies and long\-term financial plans.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decision\-making and drive the company’s growth and profitability.
* Provide financial forecasts and scenario analysis to support strategic decision\-making by the CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO.
* Product\-Level Financial Oversight
* Own the financial analysis and performance tracking of Bede’s product portfolio, including current products \- micro finance, credit cards, and remittances \- and future products as they launch, including insurance, investment options, wallet services, and other financial products.
* Build and maintain product\-level financial models to assess profitability, cost\-to\-serve, and revenue contribution for each product line.
* Work with the Director of Business and product teams to evaluate the financial viability of new product launches and enhancements before go\-to\-market.
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines set by the Central Bank of Bahrain.
* Stay updated on regulatory changes and communicate updates to the management team.
* Prepare and submit financial reports and statements to regulatory authorities as required.
* Financial Reporting
* Oversee the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial performance indicators.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for the Bede CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* Provide financial analysis and insights to support management decision\-making.
* Risk Management
* Identify and analyze financial risks and implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
* Develop and monitor key financial metrics and indicators to assess the company’s financial health and identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Expense Optimization \& Technology Investment Evaluation
* Review and analyze Bede’s operating expenses on an ongoing basis, identifying opportunities for cost optimization without compromising business growth or customer experience.
* Assess the financial business case for Bede app technology investments, including new features, infrastructure upgrades, and platform enhancements, with clear ROI tracking post\-implementation.
* Partner with department heads to instill financial discipline and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets.
* Data Analysis \& Financial Insight
* Use data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities across Bede’s financial and operational performance.
* Develop financial dashboards and reporting tools that give management clear, timely visibility into business performance.
* Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non\-financial stakeholders across the business.
* Team Leadership
* Lead and manage the finance team as it is built out over time, including hiring, training, performance management, and professional development.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the finance function.
* Stakeholder Management
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the Central Bank of Bahrain, internal and external auditors, tax authorities, and other regulatory bodies.
* Act as the primary financial point of contact between Bede and the Zain Bahrain CFO’s office, ensuring alignment on reporting standards and financial governance.
* Represent the company in financial matters and participate in industry forums and events as required.


 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including persons with disabilities and those who may require reasonable accommodations to perform their duties. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace and to ensuring that all employees are supported to succeed.
   

  

**About Application Process**

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

* Executes transactions with a risk/return approach and identifies potential opportunities for new business.



  




* Prepares, updates and reconciles Treasury and ALCO reports.



  




* Monitors political, economic and market risks and measures their potential implications on the Treasury activities.



  




* Participate actively in the system implementation and enhancement of the Treasury module.



  




* Perform duties that may be assigned by the Head of Treasury and/or Management from time to time.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a closely related quantitative field (Master’s/MBA preferred).



  




* Professional certifications such as CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CTP (Certified Treasury Professional), or ACI Dealing Certificate are highly desirable.



  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in a bank’s Treasury, Global Markets, or Asset and Liability Management (ALM) department.



  




* Proven track record in the execution and processing of day\-to\-day transactions across Money Markets, Foreign Exchange, and Fixed Income/Capital Markets.



  




* Hands\-on experience actively participating in the system implementation, migration, or upgrade of Treasury modules (e.g., Murex, Calypso, or core banking treasury systems).



  




* Demonstrated experience in networking and managing relationships with institutional clients, corporate clients, counterparties, and external brokers.



  




* Deep expertise in Liquidity Management, including regulatory metrics (LCR, NSFR), cash flow forecasting, and interest rate risk.



  




* Strict adherence to and comprehensive knowledge of compliance to regulatory, Treasury, and credit risk limits (e.g., Basel frameworks, central bank guidelines).



  




* Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to prepare ALCO reports and assess macroeconomic, political, and market risks.



  




* Ability to evaluate and execute transactions using a strategic risk/return approach.



  




* Excellent decision\-making skills to manage high\-value transactions effectively under volatile market conditions.



  




* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to the bank's code of conduct and best practices.

 : Manages, plans, directs, and coordinates all activities at the main Exchange branches and locations.

Approves leave and vacation; enforces work rules, establishes internal operating policies and procedures, and initiates programs or projects to serve mission needs. Ensures that a continuing program of training in all areas is carried out. Interviews and selects associates, completes performance appraisals. Reviews proposed disciplinary actions and resolves grievances and complaints.
* Ensures through subordinate staff, receipt, price marking, storage, custody, and proper administration and documentation under the various control procedures applicable to the receipt of merchandise.
* Ensures that a maintenance and repair program is in effect for all equipment and facilities to keep all Exchange facilities in excellent condition.
* Ensures, through subordinate supervisors, the development of an Exchange Facility Master Plan showing a five\-year projection of projects to achieve facility objectives and encompass the preliminary development of capital expenditure projects. Prepares projects for final approval, supervises their execution, and, when required, evaluates the results.
* Ensures, through subordinate managers, the implementation, administration, and coordination of all phases of the Exchange Security, Safety, and Fire Protection/Prevention Programs.
* Responsible, through subordinate managers, for the custody, protection, and accountability of Exchange property and funds.
* Participates and encourages participation in local community activities to reflect the best interests of the Navy Exchange Program.
* Ensures that an effective sales promotion program, provided by NEXCOM, is implemented to generate increased sales and traffic.
* Reports directly to the Commanding Officer, who provides broad general direction. Recommendations, comments, and resolutions are reviewed for adherence to established policies and to ensure that objectives are met. * Requires Secret (S) Security Clearance.

 governmental and regulatory authorities in Bahrain and providing end\-to\-end Government Relations
   

  

 support for both the tMart and Logistics verticals. The role ensures regulatory compliance, supports
   

  

 business continuity and expansion, and acts as the primary liaison between the Company and external
   

  

 stakeholders.

 Bahrain, providing end\-to\-end support across all operational, licensing, regulatory, labor,
   

  

 and governmental affairs matters, while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and
   

  

 supporting the expansion and day\-to\-day operations of both businesses.
   

  

  Manage and support the establishment, licensing, renewal, and ongoing regulatory
   

  

 requirements for all tMart stores, Logistics operations, riders, vehicles, and related
   

  

 facilities, ensuring uninterrupted business operations and compliance with all relevant
   

  

 governmental requirements.

 Interior, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Traffic Directorate, and other law
   

  

 enforcement authorities in relation to incidents, accidents, investigations, and official
   

  

 inquiries involving employees, riders, 3PL partners, or customers, and represent the
   

  

**Company Before Such Authorities When Required.**

 including Commercial Registration (CR), Trade License, Chamber of Commerce
   

  

 membership, import licenses, municipality licenses, and any other regulatory permits

 cancellations, amendments, and business visa processing.

 permits where required.

 employee records and invoices.

 preparation, online appointment scheduling, and coordination with the Ministry of
   

  

 Interior until issuance or renewal is completed.

 portal, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and requirements.

 Ministry of Health (MOH), National Health Regulatory Authority (NHRA), Labor Market
   

  

 Regulatory Authority (LMRA), Social Insurance Organization (SIO), and other relevant
   

  

 authorities.

 campaigns, promotions, rewards programs, and marketing initiatives from the Ministry of
   

  

 Industry, Commerce and Tourism (MOIC), Consumer Protection Authority, and other
   

  

 competent authorities.
   

  

  Support customs clearance activities and coordinate with the relevant authorities for
   

  

 import and export requirements whenever applicable.
   

  

  Lead the licensing and establishment process for new branches and locations, obtaining
   

  

 all required approvals and permits from the Ministry of Industry, municipalities, Civil
   

  

 Defense Authority, Ministry of Health, Ministry of Transportation and
   

  

 Telecommunications, and other regulatory bodies.
   

  

  Handle customer complaints filed before the Consumer Protection Authority and other
   

  

 governmental entities, represent the Company during meetings and hearings, and
   

  

 coordinate with internal stakeholders to achieve amicable resolutions.
   

  

  Prepare, attest, notarize, and legalize contracts, agreements, and corporate documents
   

  

 before the competent authorities, embassies, and public notaries whenever required.

 Responsibility (CSR) initiatives and community engagement activities.

 and intellectual property rights, and coordinate with the Trademark Authority and

Base360\.ai is building the AI operating system for B2C businesses.
   

  

 We unify every customer interaction—from social media comments and DMs to WhatsApp, email, SMS and phone calls—into a single platform powered by AI. Our mission is to replace dozens of disconnected tools with one intelligent operating system that helps businesses acquire, engage and convert customers.
   

  

 We're building ambitious products, moving fast, and looking for exceptional entrepreneurs who want to build the next generation of AI companies from within.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As an
 **Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR)** 
 , you won't be joining a department—you'll be building one.
   

  

 Your mission is to identify a major opportunity, build a new product or business vertical within Base360\.ai, assemble the right team, validate the market, and grow it into a standalone business with significant revenue and impact.
   

  

 Think of it as founding a startup—with the advantage of funding, engineering, design, AI infrastructure, customers, distribution, and executive support already behind you.
   

  

 If successful, you will become the long\-term leader of your venture.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Identify high\-potential opportunities that can become new products or business verticals.
* Validate customer problems through research and direct conversations.
* Define the product vision, strategy, and go\-to\-market plan.
* Work alongside engineering, product, design and AI teams to build and launch quickly.
* Recruit and lead your own multidisciplinary team as the venture grows.
* Own growth, product adoption, customer success and financial performance.
* Make data\-driven decisions and iterate rapidly based on customer feedback.
* Present progress directly to the founders and executive team.
* Build a business that could eventually operate as its own division—or even become an independent company.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action.
* Exceptional problem\-solving ability.
* Strong product and commercial intuition.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to recruit, inspire and lead high\-performing teams.
* Highly analytical with strong execution capabilities.
* Obsession with customers and building products people love.
* Comfortable wearing multiple hats across product, sales, marketing and operations.
* AI\-native and excited about building with the latest AI technologies.


 Previous startup experience—as a founder, early employee, product leader, operator or investor—is highly valued but not required.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**Within Your First 12–24 Months, You Will Have**
* Built and launched a new business vertical.
* Hired and led your own cross\-functional team.
* Achieved strong product\-market fit.
* Generated meaningful recurring revenue.
* Established yourself as the long\-term General Manager of your venture.


 Why Join Base360\.ai?
   

  

* Be part of an innovative and fast\-growing company building the AI operating system for B2C brands.
* Build your own venture with the backing of an experienced founding team.
* Access world\-class engineering, AI, product, design and go\-to\-market resources.
* Receive funding, mentorship and strategic support to turn your vision into reality.
* Opportunity to build a team and establish a long\-term business within Base360\.ai.
* Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives.
* Significant long\-term career growth, with the opportunity to lead an entire business unit.


**You Should NOT Apply If**
* You are looking for a corporate 9 to 5 job.
* You are political and enjoy gossiping and talking about people behind their backs.
* You are looking for a stable and slow dead\-end job.
* You do not aim to be one of the best in the world at what you do.
